937006.en: If you want things between us to be mended, you will stop bidding on this item. It would be a pity to fall out over something like this.
937006.ch: 你若还想与我修好，便不要继续争夺此物，免得耽误交情。

937007.en: That {1} belongs in my bag. Pull out now and save yourself the trouble.
937007.ch: 这{1}必将是我囊中之物，你趁早退出也落得清静。

937008.en: I'm good with treasure but not with people. Bidding may not be in your best interests.
937008.ch: 我一身神通只认宝物不认人，你再行出价恐于己不利。

937009.en: I kindly urge you to stop bidding. If you don't listen to me, well that's on your head.
937009.ch: 我好言劝阁下趁早收手，若你不听，可休怪我无情了。

937010.en: Pay close attention to who I am. Do you really want to bid on that {1}?
937010.ch: 你且看清我是何人，这{1}你还敢再出价吗？

2000201.en: Fine... I'll leave you to it.

2000301.en: You thought you could just run me off? You are quite the bully. What if I decide to stay?
2000301.ch: 刚来便想要将我赶走？你还真是霸道！我若是不走，你待如何？

2000401.en: I did not expect anyone else to be here... Another time.
2000401.ch: 想不到此地已被他人捷足先登…既然如此，我便改日再约吧。

2000801.en: ... I won't get involved. You can take care of this one!
2000801.ch: …这场战斗我不便出手，此人便交给你对付吧！

2001001.en: Hang in there, {call|B|A}... I'll get help!

2001101.en: Looks like the problem has been solved. What are we going to do now?
2001101.ch: 看来已经解决了，接下来我们要做什么呢？

2001111.en: Would you like to go on a trip with me, assuming you have the time?
2001111.ch: 若有闲暇，可否与我相约一游？

2001202.en: All work and no play makes {call|B|A} a dull boy. How would you like to visit a scenic spot with me?
2001202.ch: {call|B|A}，修炼之余也不能忘了生活逸趣，我欲邀你去一宝地游玩，你可愿意？

2001203.en: I've been planning to go somewhere nice, but it's boring to go alone. How would you like to go with me, {call|B|A}?
2001203.ch: 近日无甚要事，我寻了一处美景。一人欣赏终是无趣，于是我便想约{call|B|A}你一同前去，可好？

2001204.en: {call|B|A}, there is a place I have been dying to see. If you have time, would you like to accompany me?
2001204.ch: {call|B|A}，有一胜景我钟意许久，若你近日得闲，可愿与我结伴一游？

2001205.en: They say traveling to mountain springs with a companion can speed up cultivation. How would you like to try it with me, {call|B|A}?
2001205.ch: 我闻听人言，结伴游山玩水或可提升修炼效率，不知{call|B|A}你可愿与我一试？

2001206.en: How have you been, {call|B|A}? We should go traveling together and enjoy some quiet time. What do you say?
2001206.ch: {call|B|A}，多日不见你可安好？我想与你携手同游、享一刻静好，不知你意下如何。

2001207.en: I see you've got some free time on your hands, {call|B|A}. How would you like to take a trip together and resolve our differences amicably?
2001207.ch: {call|B|A}，我看你闲着也是闲着，便来与我同游美景，顺便化解仇怨，如何？

2001208.en: I'm not someone who likes to bear a grudge, {call|B|A}. Agree to meet me, and we can talk about our problems like civilized people.
2001208.ch: 我并非记仇之人，{call|B|A}你若答应与我相约，日后再见也有话好说，可好？

2001209.en: I'm in such a great mood today, {call|B|A}! Bumping into you, asking you out, offering you an olive branch... I hope you appreciate it.
2001209.ch: {call|B|A}，我今日心情甚好，既与你相遇便想不计前嫌约你一游，希望你不要不识抬举。

2001210.en: You and I have had our differences, {call|B|A}, but I'm feeling magnanimous. I'd like to take you somewhere quiet and bury the hatchet. What do you say?
2001210.ch: {call|B|A}，你我虽有不快在前，但我宽宏大量，主动与你相约赏景，希望就此交好，如何？

2001301.en: What a rare pleasure this is. I know you feel the same way I do. I know a secluded place, not far from {0}. How about we go there? I'll wait for you near {0} for three months.
2001301.ch: 难得机会诉说衷肠，今日你既有此意，我自当奉陪。我先前在{0}附近发现了一处幽静之地，不如我们到那边去吧。我会在{0}附近等你三个月。

2001302.en: Everyone needs to indulge themselves from time to time. If you are of a mind to, I should gladly join you. I know a grotto near {0} where people seldom go. You can follow me there.
2001302.ch: 生活也离不开闲情雅致，{call|B|A}你若有此意，我自当欣然应允。我知{0}附近的一处隐秘洞天人迹罕至，你且随去前去便可。

2001303.en: I would gladly spend the rest of my days with you, bathed in moonlight, far from the hustle and bustle of the immortal path. Speaking of which, I know a place, near {0}. It's very romantic. I shall wait on you there.
2001303.ch: 余生愿与你相约月下、共赏风花，远仙途喧嚣、品凡尘静好。说起来，我偶然闻听一妙处，便在{0}附近，风花雪月别有天地，我当在此地恭候你。

2001304.en: If you will come with me, I can show you a place of sublime beauty where we can tell each other our deepest, darkest secrets. There is a place, far away, where the mountains shine and the waters glimmer. I would like to take you there.
2001304.ch: 若得与你相约，我愿天地恒静、山河无言，只诉相思意。有一处偏僻所在，水秀山明月朗风清，我愿与你一游。

2001305.en: I recall, that meaningful glance over your shoulder, it haunts my dreams and my waking. I know a secluded place near {0}. Let's go there now.
2001305.ch: 甚好，尤忆那时，只缘感你一回顾，使我思你朝与暮，我知晓{0}附近一处幽静之地，让我们一同前去吧。

2001306.en: I have been idle these last few days. All I want to do is spend time with you. I know a place near {0} with beautiful views. I will go there and wait for you.
2001306.ch: 在下近日正巧无事，与你相约一游实合我意。我打听得{0}附近一处地方颇有几分景致，便先去那里等候你来。

2001307.en: Why not? Perfect timing. There's a great spot near {0}. Right now is the perfect time to travel there. I'll wait there for three months. Don't forget.
2001307.ch: 有何不可？你来得正是时候，距{0}附近不远有一福地，近日刚巧是此地最宜游览之时，你我三月为期，可别忘了。

2001308.en: You haven't always been my favorite person, but this invitation has changed my opinion of you. When I'm feeling low there's a quiet place I like to go near {0}. I will wait for you there for three months. I hope you're not teasing me.
2001308.ch: 我承认自己先前对你有几分成见，可如今你主动邀我，这倒不禁令我稍有改观。我私下烦闷时常去{0}附近的一处僻静之所休憩，今我在那里候你三月，愿你不是戏耍我。

2001309.en: Cultivators aspire to live in harmony. I'm sure we can overcome our differences. Since you are willing, how could I refuse? To demonstrate my good intentions, I will go towards {0} and wait for you there for three months. Don't keep me waiting!
2001309.ch: 我自知八荒修仙者间宜以和为贵、共抗天劫兽灾，你我仇怨自然可以化解。如今你既有意，我怎好拒绝？为表坦诚，我先去{0}附近等候你三月，望你速来。

2001310.en: I always treat people fairly. Since you have made the first move, I shall give you a chance. There is a good place, not far from {0}. I will go there and wait for you. You'd better take advantage of this good fortune!
2001310.ch: 我平生待人接物自有一套原则，现你主动约我，我便给你一次机会。久闻{0}不远处有一块宝地，我便先去那里等你，你可要好好珍惜这番机缘。

2001311.en: You and I have had our differences, but to find the Tao one must first cultivate the heart. I'm quite modern and don't like holding grudges. Since you have asked me out, let me take you to a beautiful place I know near {0}. You'd better not stand me up!
2001311.ch: 你我虽多有不睦，然而求道先要修心，我既并非旧时性情，便也愿放下仇恨。今你邀我，我便带你同游{0}附近的一处胜景，你可不要失约。

2001401.en: I know a secluded place, not far from {0}. How about we go there? I'll wait for you near {0} for three months.
2001401.ch: 我先前在{0}附近发现了一处幽静之地，不如我们到那边去吧。我会在{0}附近等你三个月。

2001402.en: Wonderful. I knew you deserved my devotion. I'll wait for you near {0} for three months.
2001402.ch: 如此甚好，我就知你必然不会负我一片心意。我会在{0}附近等你三个月。

2001403.en: Well, in that case I'll wait for you near {0} for three months.
2001403.ch: 既如此，我便先去{0}附近等你三个月。

2001404.en: Okay, I'll wait for you near {0} for three months.
2001404.ch: 那好，我会在{0}附近等你三个月。

2001405.en: Okay, I'll wait for you near {0} for three months. As we've agreed, please don't keep me waiting too long.
2001405.ch: 好！我会在{0}附近等你三个月。既然答应，还请你勿要让我久候。

2001406.en: Okay, I'll head over there first. You can follow on behind. I'll wait for you near {0} for three months.
2001406.ch: 那我先行一步，你随后赶来便是。我会在{0}附近等你三个月。

2001501.en: I don't want to be alone with you...

2001502.en: You want to ask me out? Please don't embarrass yourself.
2001502.ch: 就凭你也想约我？劝你别自取其辱。

2001503.en: I would rather face Dangkang than spend one more second with you.
2001503.ch: 我宁愿直面当康，也不想和你多待一秒。

2001504.en: Ew, so vulgar. Don't embarrass yourself. GET LOST!!!
2001504.ch: 如此形陋之人就别自取其辱了，给我滚！

2001505.en: I've been a bit busy. Maybe next time.
2001505.ch: 我近日颇为繁忙，不如下次吧。

2001506.en: I'm on a mission. I can't really spare the time.
2001506.ch: 我还有使命在身，这一阵难以抽空。

2001507.en: I'd like to {call|B|A}, but I'm doing something super important right now. We can discuss our feelings later.
2001507.ch: {call|B|A}，非我不愿相会，只是近日确要事在身，儿女私情以后再说吧。

2001508.en: I already have someone special. I can't be alone with you.
2001508.ch: 我已有心仪之人，我不能与你单独相处。

2001601.en: You look busy. Come and find me when you've got a moment.
2001601.ch: 你似乎已有约在身，待到闲时再来寻我吧。

2001701.en: I'm a little tired. How about we make it another day?
2001701.ch: 我有些疲惫了，不如我们日后再约吧。

2001801.en: There you are... I've been waiting for ages.
2001801.ch: 你来了…我已在此地等候多时了。

2002201.en: (Do you want to leave this area?)

2002251.en: Today has been a joy, but the hour is late. It is time for us to say goodbye. Until next time.
2002251.ch: 今日相会，甚是欢愉。然时辰已晚，你我暂别，他日有缘再聚。

2002252.en: Today has been most rewarding. May you attain the Great Path soon, {call|B|A}.
2002252.ch: 今日与你相会一场，我收获颇丰，愿{call|B|A}你早成大道。

2002253.en: Today was an absolute pleasure I won't soon forget. May we do it all again soon!
2002253.ch: 今日与你一聚，乘兴而来，兴尽而归，实在畅快，后会有期。

2002254.en: How the time has flown! Alas the time has come to say goodbye. Safe travels and don't be a stranger!
2002254.ch: 时光如此匆匆，转眼竟到了分别之时，愿你一路安好，有空多来寻我。

2002255.en: I hate to say goodbye, but we each have our responsibilities and the world demands our attention. Think of me often and we shall meet again.
2002255.ch: 我自有万分不舍也知聚少离多之理，世道无常，你我各自珍重，他日再会。

2002256.en: Our time together has ended. It's time to say goodbye. Stay young and keep the flame alive.
2002256.ch: 今日就此别过，再见之时，愿你依旧年少，顾盼如昨。

2002257.en: A pleasant journey through spectacular scenery. What a blessing. Until we meet again.
2002257.ch: 山水一程，三生有幸，此番分别，他日再会。

2002258.en: All good thing must come to an end. It is time for us to say goodbye. Farewell.
2002258.ch: 相聚日久终有一别，今与尽欢一场，就此告辞。

2002259.en: The time has come for us to say goodbye, but our memories will be with us forever. Think of me often.
2002259.ch: 虽有离别日，但念相逢时。你日后可要多记挂我。

2002261.en: Today has been very stimulating, but also quite exhausting.
2002261.ch: 今日相谈甚欢，却也有些疲惫。

2002281.en: I'm feeling quite tired already. How about we do something else for a while?
2002281.ch: 我已经很疲惫了，不如我们去做一些其他事情吧。

2002301.en: Do you know a game, the board is square and static, while the pieces are round and in motion—that follows the pattern of heaven and earth?
2002301.ch: 你可知一戏，局方而静，棋圆而动，以法天地，解之可窥大道？

2002401.en: The mortal world is full of turmoil. To share a cup of tea with you {call|B|A} brings a rare moment of sweet repose.
2002401.ch: 尘世喧嚣，若得暇与{call|B|A}你共品涤烦子，享一刻清幽静谧，岂不是人间美事。

2002501.en: We are to these fish what the Great Path is to us. Perhaps the mana we receive is scant more than breadcrumbs dropped by immortals in Heaven. It is a practice that can enlighten.
2002501.ch: 水中鱼儿之于修仙者，便如同我等修仙者之于天道。八荒灵气，或许不过是天外之仙的寥寥喂养，若行此举，或能有所感悟。

2002601.en: The Path to Immortality is long and hard. To sit and drink freshly brewed wine with you is a rare pleasure indeed!
2002601.ch: 求仙之路道阻且长，若得暇共饮绿蚁，对坐闲谈，岂不美哉！

2002701.en: I hear there is a place where the willow grows by the steps and sweet floral fragrance fills the courtyard. The thought of sharing it with you fills my heart with joy.
2002701.ch: 听闻此地有处景致阶柳庭花、桂馥兰香。想到能与你一同观赏此景，真是让人喜不自胜。

2002801.en: Yes! Good idea. There is much you can teach me.
2002801.ch: 好！机会难得，今日且向你讨教一番。

2002901.en: Brilliant move! You are a master of the game... Lesson learned.
2002901.ch: 这一手着实是妙！想不到你的棋力竟如此之高…受教了。

2003001.en: Wonderful. There's nothing quite like sharing a good cup of tea and idle conversation.
2003001.ch: 甚好，能与你在此地共饮瓯蚁，对坐闲谈，倒也别有一番风味。

2003101.ch: 想不到你的格调竟如此高雅。

2003201.en: What a pleasure! There is nothing quite like watching spirits frolic in the water.
2003201.ch: 甚合我意，水中生灵嬉戏玩闹，倒也别有一番逸趣。

2003301.en: What insight can be gained from watching the fish?
2003301.ch: 你可从观鱼之中悟出些许道理？

2003401.en: Wonderful! The mortal world is full of turmoil. Drowning my sorrows in your company a brings a rare moment of sweet repose.
2003401.ch: 甚好！尘世喧嚣，得暇与你共品忘忧之物，享一刻迷醉糊涂，岂不是人间美事。

2003501.en: How intrepid and carefree you are! Such a treat!
2003501.ch: 想不到你豪迈洒脱，真是畅快！

2003601.en: Sure, I will come with you.

2003701.en: How refined and well-mannered you are!
2003701.ch: 想不到你如此逸趣可人。

2004001.en: {call|C|A}, who is {gender|B}?... Why should I leave?

2004301.en: How dare you seduce my {relation|A|C}! You'll pay for this!
2004301.ch: 你竟然敢勾搭我的{relation|A|C}！今日，我便要让你付出代价！

2004401.en: {call|C|A}, how can you treat me like this?... In that case, I'm outta here.
2004401.ch: {call|C|A}，你怎能如此对待我…既然如此，我离开便是。

2004501.en: {call|C|A}, how can you treat me like this?...I'm not going anywhere!

2004601.en: I accepted your invitation {call|B|A} and went to all this trouble to find this place... only to have you treat me like this! What's the hell is wrong with you?
2004601.ch: {call|B|A}，我回应你的邀约，费尽心思的寻了一处幽静之地…你现在如此对待我，敢问你良心何在？我真是看错你了！

2004701.en: I was so good to you {call|C|A}! Not only did you fool around on me... you hurt me to win over someone else ... I'm dead inside.
2004701.ch: {call|C|A}，我如此真诚的对待你，而你不仅背着我拈花惹草…还要为了讨好别人而伤我…我心已死…

2004801.en: Keep your wretched life. Get out of here.

2004901.en: I was so good to you {call|C|A} but you played me like a fool... I was wrong about you!
2004901.ch: {call|C|A}，我如此真诚的对待你，而你却背着我在外沾花惹草…我真是看错你了！

2005101.en: Hah! You never stop! You even stole my man!
2005101.ch: 哼！真是不识好歹，竟敢跟我抢男人！

2005301.en: Hah! You never stop! You even stole my woman!
2005301.ch: 哼！真是不识好歹，竟敢跟我抢女人！

2005601.en: {call|B|A}, I don't really feel up to it today... Maybe another day.
2005601.ch: {call|B|A}，今日我兴致全无…不如改日再约吧。

2005801.en: You don't scare me! If it's a fight you want, let's fight!
2005801.ch: 我还会怕你不成！要战便战！

2005901.en: (This is crazy. Better get out of here...)
2005901.ch: （此地场面过于混乱，我还是走为上计…）

2006201.en: I never expected a vulgar person like you to be so interested in travel...
2006201.ch: 想不到你这种低俗的人竟也有雅兴来此游玩…

2006301.en: Oh? So this is your intended?
2006301.ch: 哦？看来这位便是你的心仪之人了？

2006501.ch: 品味不错，其貌如你一般不堪入目！

2006601.en: ... Since someone ruined our fun, let's do it another time!
2006601.ch: …既然今日有人扫兴，那便下次再约吧！

2006701.en: Kitty's got claws. You don't scare me! BRING IT!!!
2006701.ch: 脾气还挺大，我还怕你不成？！放马过来！

2007101.en: I hadn't realized you were reaching out to me for the {0} seat. I was wrong about you.
2007101.ch: 没想到你约我竟是为了{0}之位，我真是看错人了

2100101.en: Can... can you spare an elixir that restores vitality? I've been wounded by the monsters in the area, and not sure how long I can last...
2100101.ch: 你…能不能…给我一颗回复体力的丹药？我被此地的妖兽所伤，已经快撑不住了…

2100201.en: Um, I'm not getting any better. I don't think this restores vitality...
2100201.ch: 唔…完全没有好转…这似乎不是回复体力的丹药。

2100301.en: You... poisoned me? I will haunt you forever!
2100301.ch: 你竟然…给我下毒？！我做鬼也不会放过你的！

2100601.en: The monsters here are very powerful and difficult to handle.
2100601.ch: 此地的妖物厉害得很，怕是不好对付！

2100701.en: Let's fight our way out of here together!
2100701.ch: 让我们联手击败它，逃离此地吧！

2100901.en: We made it! You're more powerful than I thought!
2100901.ch: 我们成功了！道友果然厉害！

2101001.en: Thank you for saving me today.
2101001.ch: 今日，多谢道友出手相救！

2101101.ch: 我这里有{mapData128}，便赠予道友吧！

2101201.en: I will not forget your generosity. Should you need me, I will help.
2101201.ch: 道友今日救命之恩，在下没齿难忘！日后若有所需，在下定会鼎力相助！

2101301.en: I would like to thank you, but I am low on funds...
2101301.ch: 虽然在下非常想报答道友的救命之恩，但此时我囊中羞涩、身无分文…

2101401.en: I will repay you some day!
2101401.ch: 来日…我定会报答道友的救命之恩！

2101501.en: I would love to repay you, but I don't have any money.
2101501.ch: 虽然我很想报答你，但我现在身无分文…嘿嘿！

2200001.en: {call|B|A}, I heard that {0} is planning revenge against you. Stay alert!
2200001.ch: {call|B|A}，近日我听到风声，{0}似乎在计划着向你报仇…你可千万要当心！

2200002.en: If my guess is right, {call|B|A}, {0} and {1} are working together to take you down. Stay alert!
2200002.ch: {call|B|A}，若我猜得不错，{0}与{1}似乎准备联手起来对付你，你可千万要小心呀！

2300001.ch: 你竟敢杀害{0}，今日我便要替{0}报仇！

2301001.en: You might have won today, {call|C|A}, but you will die when I bring {1} with me next time!
2301001.ch: {call|C|A}，你或许很强，但今日我与{1}联手，你必死无疑！

3000001.en: (On a night of good company and exquisite verse recited under the moon, you inadvertently drink one too many cups of wine. Your head swimming, you feel power rise up inside you, like a great tide)
3000001.ch: （风花雪月、佳人相伴，值此良辰，你无意间便多贪了几杯，头晕目眩之际感觉自身灵力澎湃、气势磅礴）

3000101.en: (On a night of good company and exquisite verse recited under the moon, you inadvertently drink one too many cups of wine. Your head swimming, you feel your pulse quicken and visions of grandeur fill your mind)
3000101.ch: （风花雪月、佳人相伴，值此良辰，你无意间便多贪了几杯，头晕目眩之际突感自身血气上涌、豪情顿生）

3000201.en: There's something unusual about this garden. Could be a monster. You wait here {call|A|B}, while I go and investigate.
3000201.ch: 这花园似是有些反常，莫非有妖兽混入？且待我前去查探一番，{call|A|B}你留在此处即可。

3000301.en: The Flower Faeries here are completely feral, {call|A|B}. How are you doing? Let's go to the pavilion and rest for a while.
3000301.ch: 此地花妖野性未减，{call|A|B}，你情况如何？我们先去亭子里休养一会儿。

3000401.en: (As you watch the fish frolicking in the water, your companion sneaks up behind you and gives you a little shove. You pretend to lose your footing and grab onto their sleeve. Both of you fall into the water and spend some time splashing each other and laughing happily)
3000401.ch: （观赏鱼儿嬉闹时，对方趁你不注意淘气地偷偷从后面推了你一把，你装作站立不稳顺势将其拖拽着一起掉进了水里，快乐地嬉戏了一番。）

3000501.en: I wasn't expecting to find that here, {call|A|B}. How are you doing? Let's go to the pavilion and rest for a while.
3000501.ch: 没想到此地竟出现了这等妖兽，{call|A|B}，你情况如何？我们去亭子里休养一会儿。

4110001.en: {call|B|A}, do I look good in this?
4110001.ch: {call|B|A}，你看我换上这套衣服可还合身…？

4110101.en: Thank you for the clothes, {call|B|A}. I feel a lot better!
4110101.ch: {call|B|A}，谢谢你送我的衣服，换一套衣服后感觉心情都变好了！

4110201.en: Thank you for the clothes, {call|B|A}. Let's take a walk!
4110201.ch: {call|B|A}，谢谢你送我的衣服，这就出门走走！

4110301.en: I've wanted this for a long time, {call|B|A}. You're sweet!
4110301.ch: {call|B|A}，我早就想要这套衣服了，你真贴心。

4111101.en: This goes great with how you carry yourself, {call|B|A}. Handsome and refreshing.
4111101.ch: {call|B|A}，这件衣服配上你仙风道骨的气质，真是清新俊逸，品貌非凡。

4112101.en: Bright eyes and pink cheeks, you looks great in this.
4112101.ch: 面若桃花，双瞳剪水，{call|B|A}换上这身衣服，真是翩若惊鸿，婉若游龙。

5101001.en: Uhn... did you wake me up from the underworld?
5101001.ch: 嗯……是你把我从冥界中唤醒的吗？

5101011.en: Why did this happen again? I swore that I would never let another companion die in front of me...
5101011.ch: 为什么又会这样……我明明发过誓，不会再让同伴死在自己面前……

5101013.en: If I don't grow attached to you, then I will not be said when we part.
5101013.ch: 倘若不与你生出情愫，离别之际就不会伤心难过……

5101021.en: You're really alive? Hm? What I just said? ...I didn't say anything. You must have heard wrong.
5101021.ch: 你真的还活着？嗯？我刚刚说的话？……我什么都没说啊，你一定是听错了！

5101031.ch: 阁下修行有成，恭喜恭喜！

5101041.en: And this is the trial of lightning? You must have reached a higher place. I have never seen this in the heavenly realm.
5101041.ch: 这就是雷劫吗？看来阁下造化不浅，我在仙界可从没遇过呢！

5101042.en: I wonder what's it like to be hit by lightning.
5101042.ch: 被雷劈是什么感觉？我还真想体验一下。

5101051.en: Watch out! Allow me to help you.

5101061.en: What do you have with you? May I take a look first?
5101061.ch: 你带着什么好东西呢？能不能先让我瞧瞧？

5101063.ch: 遇到这种事还真是令人苦恼。

5101072.en: I still get nervous in places like these.
5101072.ch: 走到这种地方，我心中还是会不自觉紧张起来呢……

5101081.en: That's a lot of pretty clothes! Can I try them on? No? How come?
5101081.ch: 哇！这么多漂亮的衣服，我可以都试穿一下吗？不可以吗？诶，怎么这样！

5101082.en: This skirt comes down very nicely.
5101082.ch: 这条裙子垂坠感可真不错呢！

5101091.en: Oops, did I make him see things?
5101091.ch: 哎呀，一不小心让他出幻觉了吧……

5101092.en: He's as good as dead as long as I don't remove the phantoms. You don't even need to kill him.
5101092.ch: 就算你不杀此人，只要我不解开幻障，此人也跟死了没两样。

5101094.en: That's not really what I'm thinking.
5101094.ch: 你跟我想的有点不同啊。

5101095.en: Do you have anything against him?
5101095.ch: 此人跟你有仇？看起来不像啊。

5101096.en: Are you having a bad day and taking it out on him?
5101096.ch: 你是不是有什么不开心，所以出手发泄？

5101097.en: I can't condone what you've done today.
5101097.ch: 你今日行径恕我不敢苟同。

5101100.en: It pains me greatly to see what you're doing.
5101100.ch: 看见你这样做，我心中好似针戳一样，难受无比。

5101101.en: If I were you, I'd do everything I can to protect those that are important to me.
5101101.ch: 如果是我啊，绝对会尽力保护对自己重要的人呢……

5101102.en: Family is important. How can you...
5101102.ch: 亲族都是重要的人啊，你怎么能……

5101115.en: Have mercy! It's just a pedestrian.
5101115.ch: 手下留情，此人不就是个路人嘛？

5101131.en: I remember my brother used to be incredibly kind to me.
5101131.ch: 记得从前我哥也对我特别好……

5101143.en: Should I prepare something for you to give to your new master?
5101143.ch: 要不要给你准备点拜师礼？

5102001.ch: 咳咳……这一把老骨头真是不经折腾……

5102011.en: I'm sorry... I had lost my edge and couldn't protect you.
5102011.ch: 唉，都怪老夫修为大损，没能护住小友……

5102013.en: I have almost never lost in battle, but I can't even protect a single person now...
5102013.ch: 老夫一生冲阵几无败绩，眼下竟连一个人都保护不了么？！

5102021.en: What?! How did you... come back alive?
5102021.ch: 什么！小友如此厉害，竟能死而复生？

5102022.en: Is this what they call... breaking the rules?
5102022.ch: 莫非这便是传说中的破而后立……

5102023.en: Have you been enlightened to look past life and death?
5102023.ch: 生死一如，小友已经参悟到这样程度了么？

5102031.ch: 小友境界突破、实在是可喜可贺！

5102032.en: You must persevere to achieve greatness.
5102032.ch: 小友今后仍须坚持不懈方得大成。

5102033.en: Work hard, and one day everything will fall into place.
5102033.ch: 勤修不辍，自然水到渠成。

5102041.en: Everything is destined. Do not fret.
5102041.ch: 天道自有定数，小友不必气馁。

5102061.ch: 嗯？刚刚莫非是老夫眼花了？

5102062.en: Were you hoping that no one would see what you've done?
5102062.ch: 做此行径，还望他人不知道么？

5102071.ch: 这儿的小家伙可真不少，一片生机勃勃的景象啊！

5102072.en: I can feel the evil inside. Should we take a look?
5102072.ch: 有妖气，你我进入一觑如何？

5102073.en: This is far from safe, but that's not to say we can't go inside.
5102073.ch: 此间虽不太平，但也并非不能一探。

5102081.en: Ahem. The feng shui of this area looks very good. Why don't you hang out here for a while?
5102081.ch: 咳咳，老夫观此地风水不错，小友不妨进去坐会儿……

5102082.en: Alcohol is the food of sages. Since we're here, we might as well have some.
5102082.ch: 酒乃圣人粮食，既然路过，且进去吃一盅如何？

5102083.en: I am feeling unwell. I think the alcohol bug is acting up!
5102083.ch: 老夫略有不适，似是腹中酒虫发作！

5102091.en: It's karma that this man's life ended so horribly.
5102091.ch: 天道好还，此人终是得此惨淡收场。

5102092.en: You finally had your revenge. How does it feel?
5102092.ch: 往日之仇，今日终于得报，小友心中畅快否？

5102094.en: Immortals and mortals are the same when it comes to the evil within. But one must hold back in order to avoid karma.
5102094.ch: 唉，仙凡无差，不离人心鬼蜮，不为已甚，后报始得不恶。

5102096.en: Even though they said the kind shall not lead soldiers, I still cannot condone your behavior.
5102096.ch: 虽说慈不掌兵，但老朽观阁下如此行径，仍然不敢苟同。

5102099.en: If you were good friends, how did you end up like this?
5102099.ch: 既是良友，如何翻脸若此？

5102111.en: There is no hurry, my friend. One day, we will get them.
5102111.ch: 小友勿急，天网恢恢，总有一日他要落在我们手中。

5102114.en: They might regroup and return some day. You should be careful.
5102114.ch: 此人落荒逃去，难保日后卷土重来，小友可得小心在意。

5102115.en: It is not good to get into fights often and make enemies, because it might jeopardize the safety of the rest of your journey.
5102115.ch: 妄动刀兵，随意结怨。若是一直如此，阁下日后道路未必如此平坦。

5102116.en: I believe you said you're a cultivator looking for answers. Why do you clash with others so often?
5102116.ch: 小友有志参天问道，何苦与他人动辄刀剑相向？

5102117.en: You were great friends. Why not think about your friendship and let them go?
5102117.ch: 尔等原本亲同股肱，念在昔日情谊，且饶他一命罢了。

5102119.en: What happened between the two of you?

5102120.en: You should have mercy on them.
5102120.ch: 此人与你有旧，还是留手为好。

5102121.en: You're still young and reckless, maybe you should reconsider and let them go.
5102121.ch: 年轻人勿要戾气过甚，由此人去吧。

5102122.en: You have many friends. Do you always want to kill them when things don't go your way?
5102122.ch: 阁下胜友如云，难道稍有不合便动杀心？

5102131.en: Wouldn't it be nice to make new friends and become immortals together?
5102131.ch: 小友多了羁绊，他日同列仙班，共游太虚，岂不美哉？

5102132.en: I had a very good friend, but we didn't bone.
5102132.ch: 老夫昔日有一忘年之交，只遗憾未能与其结义。

5102133.en: I thought this person was extraordinary. I didn't know you were related.
5102133.ch: 老夫观此人道骨郁郁必非凡器，不意却是小友异姓之亲。

5102141.en: You should work hard and let your talents bloom. I can already see you achieving great things.
5102141.ch: 小友既得桃李，当下用心栽培，异日青出于蓝，已可想见。

5102142.en: I can't believe how fast time flies, and that you're already a master with students.
5102142.ch: 与阁下相见仿如昨日，岂知晃眼间小友便已为人师表。

5103013.en: I thought you'd at least put up a fight.

5103023.ch: 死而复生？倒还有点本事。

5103042.en: I can't believe this. A mere breakthrough bring about a trial...

5103051.en: How dare you touch my people! Die!
5103051.ch: 哪来的蝼蚁，连我的人也敢动，找死！

5103092.en: That's all you got? And you actually killed someone? Ridiculous.
5103092.ch: 这点实力，竟还与人结仇？可笑。

5103093.en: I didn't think you'd last longer than an hour.
5103093.ch: 半炷香就躺下了，倒也在意料之中。

5103094.en: Is this person supposed to die?

5103099.ch: 若有缘故，也不是不能动手。

5103102.en: I hope there's still a shred of sanity left in you.

5103111.en: You run away faster than you fight.
5103111.ch: 脚上功夫倒比手上功夫强了不少。

5103112.en: Does this person have four legs or what?

5103113.en: I guess they'll run away next time.
5103113.ch: 下次大约就是闻风而逃了。

5103115.en: This person would have been dead.
5103115.ch: 若在从前，此人早已毙命。

5103117.en: You stopped on purpose, didn't you?

5103119.ch: 方才大好良机，竟下不去手。

5103131.ch: 哼哼，现在才记得找个师父么?

5103133.en: Strict masters have excellent students. It was too late when I realized that.
5103133.ch: 严师多出高徒。当我明白此言之时，却已晚了。

5103141.en: To be frank, I'm a little envious.
5103141.ch: 实话说，我多少有些艳羡。

5103142.en: I was always a lone wolf, and never had close friends. Now, I think I regret it a little...
5103142.ch: 从前独来独往，不曾有过知心好友，现在想来，许是有些遗憾……

5103143.en: It's good to have someone to travel with in this world.
5103143.ch: 天涯路远，不必独往，这是好事。

5103151.en: It was a lot of work trying to misdirect those weaklings. I won't help you next time.
5103151.ch: 遮掩那些蝼蚁的耳目还真是麻烦，下次我可不会再帮你。

5104001.en: How long did I sleep? And... who are you? Did grandpa send you?
5104001.ch: 呃……我这是睡了多久……嗯？你是谁呀？是爷爷派你来的吗？

5104011.en: Hey, are you alright? Wake up! I will never slack off again!
5104011.ch: 呀！你怎么了，快醒醒，沐晴再也不会偷懒了，呜呜呜……

5104012.en: Hey, I'll play your favorite songs! Get up!
5104012.ch: 我给弹你喜欢的乐曲，你起来、起来……

5104021.en: You're back! They must have heard my call. That must be it!
5104021.ch: 喔！你怎么又活啦！一定是上天听到了沐晴的呼唤，才复活你的吧！一定是吧！

5104032.en: Will you teach me something? I want to get better!
5104032.ch: 有没有什么秘诀可以教给沐晴，人家也好想再破一重境界呢！

5104041.en: Looks like a storm is coming. I'm going back into the artifact. You just sit tight, and it'll all be over soon.
5104041.ch: 啊……要打雷了呢，沐晴先回法宝里收衣服去了，你忍着点，很快就会过去的。

5104042.en: You will live, I'm sure of it. But I have to go now!
5104042.ch: 加油，你一定能活下来的，我先告辞了！

5104051.en: Bad guys! Let me hide first!
5104051.ch: 呀！有坏人来啦！快让沐晴躲起来！

5104061.en: Hey, it's the thief! Teach them a lesson for me!
5104061.ch: 哼！是小偷，快给我好好教训此人！

5104071.en: I've been looking at the stars, and they show that bad things are up ahead. You should take a detour... I'm really scared!
5104071.ch: 我夜观天象，前方有大凶之兆，沐晴劝你最好绕道而行……啊啊啊，人家好害怕嘛！

5104072.en: I don't like how the air here feels... gloomy.
5104072.ch: 这里阴风阵阵，怪可怕的！

5104081.en: Hey, do you have those expensive instruments? I don't want to know the price, but I want to see them! I really just want to look at them.
5104081.ch: 掌柜的，那种名贵的乐器有卖吗？不看价格赶紧拿出来吧！嘘，人家真的只是想看看而已哟……

5104101.en: You're a little different than I thought...
5104101.ch: 你好像跟沐晴想象中的有点不一样……

5104102.en: You were very nice and kind. I want you to go back to that...
5104102.ch: 从前你很温柔，沐晴希望你变成从前那样。

5104117.en: Alright, they're gone. But I thought you were friends?
5104117.ch: 好了好了，逃了就算啦，你们不是朋友嘛？

5104118.en: I didn't want to do it, so I let them go.
5104118.ch: 沐晴有点不忍心，所以放过了那家伙……

5104120.en: Have you always been like that?
5104120.ch: 喂喂，你一直都是这样的嘛？

5104121.en: Here, let me play you something. Are you ready?
5104121.ch: 来来来，沐晴给你弹一曲，你来听，来听！

5104131.en: You want to take a break? Then relax and let me play you something.
5104131.ch: 你想要休息了吗？那么就请放松身心，听沐晴为你奏上一曲……

5104142.en: Was it someone like... a grandfather?
5104142.ch: 唔，是爷爷一样的人物么？

5104143.en: Looking at your bond, I kind of miss my grandpa.
5104143.ch: 看见你结义，沐晴想爷爷了……

5104151.en: But he's not going to bug me too, right?
5104151.ch: 糟糕！这家伙以后不会也来管我吧？

5104152.en: My master was very kind to me. It's nice to have one.
5104152.ch: 从前师父对沐晴很好，有师父是一件很好的事情呢。

5105001.en: So this is the underworld? Nothing fancy. Wait, why aren't you dead? Who are you?
5105001.ch: 这里便是传说中的冥界？也没什么大不了的嘛。啊啊，怎么有个大活人在这里！你是谁啊！

5105011.en: Go back! We can't go down here! Ugh, we... have to.. hold on...
5105011.ch: 快退后，咱们还不能倒在这里！呃……真的撑不住了吗，可恶……

5105012.en: How can this be? I tried really hard, but you still went down...
5105012.ch: 不会吧？我都这么努力了，你怎么还是倒下了？

5105021.en: This person is supposed to be dead! Why are they moving?!
5105021.ch: 妈呀！这死人突然诈尸啦！

5105031.en: Your cultivation speed is amazing! You're almost all caught up!
5105031.ch: 你的修炼速度好生惊人，就快赶上我啦！

5105032.en: I've decided that I'm going to sleep less and cultivate more, so I can keep up with you.
5105032.ch: 我决定以后少睡一点，多多修炼！不然都比不过你了。

5105033.ch: 啊啊啊！你不困的么？怎么又突破了……

5105041.en: I was hit by lightning quite a few times during my time in the heavenly realm.
5105041.ch: 唉，我当年在仙界那会儿也没少挨雷劈，一想到这我就全身酥麻。

5105043.en: The lightning seems alright. I think you'll be fine.
5105043.ch: 这个雷的威力，我看一般，你安心承受吧！

5105051.en: Stop what you're doing right now!

5105052.ch: 有什么道儿，都朝我身上招呼吧！

5105053.en: That's too much. Let me show my true form to scare them away!
5105053.ch: 欺人太甚，等我现出真身吓死他们！

5105061.en: I hate sneaky types like you. Why don't we fight in the open?
5105061.ch: 在下最烦这等偷鸡摸狗之辈，够胆就堂堂正正地对决吧！

5105062.en: This person was just trying to steal from you!
5105062.ch: 喂，我抓住一个人，他正朝你兜里摸呢！

5105063.en: Is this what they call a skilled thief? Doesn't look that skilled after all...
5105063.ch: 这难道就是传说中的妙手空空么？好像不太聪明的样子。

5105071.en: Something... smells familiar. Are my people down here too?
5105071.ch: 诶哟，有种熟悉的气息，莫非此界有不少我的同族？

5105072.en: I can smell the evil in the air.
5105072.ch: 我抽抽鼻子就闻到一阵妖气。

5105081.en: I miss my days as a blacksmith. Excuse me, can I get two heavy hammers forged?
5105081.ch: 真是怀念儿时打铁的日子。店家，能给在下打上两把五百斤重的大铁锤吗？

5105082.en: That's not the right way. Hand me the hammer and let me show you.
5105082.ch: 兄弟，你这样敲不对，要么你将锤子给我，我来敲两记给示范示范？

5105083.en: I see you have some good stuff here. Let me take a look.
5105083.ch: 此处可有些成品的上等货色，我来品评品评。

5105091.en: This person bit off more than they could chew.

5105092.en: I haven't even started, and you're down already?
5105092.ch: 我还没使劲，此人这就躺下了？

5105095.ch: 你跟这个人有什么仇怨？

5105099.en: I... I'm confused. What's going on?
5105099.ch: 我……我有点搞不清现在是什么状况……

5105114.en: You don't even know them, why did you beat them up?
5105114.ch: 素不相识的，你干嘛揍别人？

5105116.en: I don't think we know them.
5105116.ch: 我印象中，咱好像不认识这个人吧？

5105117.en: I might not be the smartest person out there, but even I know killing a friend is wrong.
5105117.ch: 都说我有点憨厚迟钝，但你杀死朋友，就是再蠢都知道不对啊。

5105119.en: I'm your friend, and I can't let you go down this path! Stop right now!
5105119.ch: 我是你的朋友，不能让你一直错下去！饶过此人吧。

5105121.ch: 停停停！别追了，你们不是亲人吗？

5105132.en: I just thought of a girl...
5105132.ch: 唔，我脑海中浮起了一个姑娘的影子……

5105143.en: I had to fight against someone very good from my tribe, and I won a lot, too! Just like you.
5105143.ch: 我当年也要跟同族高手比试，而且跟你一样我也常常获胜呢！

5105152.en: I'll teach you a few things, and you'll win next time.
5105152.ch: 下次我教你几招！你一定能赢。

5105153.en: If I were you, I'd just headbutt them and take them down.
5105153.ch: 要是我啊，一头撞过去就将人拱倒了。

5105201.en: Lingge wakes you up shortly after you fall asleep to train, but you feel rejuvenated.
5105201.ch: 你刚睡下没一会儿，姜菱歌就拉着你起床修炼了，不过你却感觉精神恢复得格外好。

5105202.en: You wake up from your nap and see Lingge grilling meat next to you. Looks like she wants to invite you to eat together.
5105202.ch: 这日，你小憩已毕，突然发现姜菱歌在一旁生火烤肉，看样子她似乎想邀请你共同进食。

5105203.en: What are you looking at? Come cook with me!
5105203.ch: 看啥看啊，快来帮着烤啊！

5105204.en: Hm? Where did I get the meat from? I can't tell you.
5105204.ch: 嗯？你问肉从哪儿来的？那我不能告诉你。

5105206.en: After eating the grilled meat, you feel full of vitality and strength.
5105206.ch: 烤肉下肚，你觉得气血充盈，力量大增。

5105207.en: After eating the grilled meat, you ache all over, as if something evil is inside you.
5105207.ch: 烤肉下肚，你觉得体内疼痛难忍，似乎中了妖邪之气。

5105208.ch: 嘿嘿，那这些可都归我了！

5105209.en: Mengyi is still putting on makeup, but you've been waiting for her for a long time...
5105209.ch: 云梦衣还在对着镜子梳妆，然而你已经等了她很久很久……

5105210.ch: 稍等一会哟，很快就好了！

5105213.en: You suddenly get down and fall asleep on the side of the road. Muqing can only hum to herself to kill time.
5105213.ch: 你行至半路突然倒在地上呼呼大睡，小沐晴只能在一旁百无聊赖地哼歌解闷。

5105214.en: Muqing jumps out anxiously, seeing you taking an elixir.
5105214.ch: 看到你服用丹药，沐晴一脸焦急地跳了出来。

5105215.en: That's a lot of medicine. Are you unwell?
5105215.ch: 吃这么多药，你是不是病了呀？

5105217.en: You arrive at Tree Vault and see Muqing taking Jingwei by the hand, whispering something.
5105217.ch: 你来到建木，发现小沐晴正拉着精卫的手，两人在说些什么悄悄话。

5105220.en: And... I'll stop here. Stay tuned!
5105220.ch: 嗯，先说到这……且听下回分解……

5105222.en: You leave the city and see Jiuchen being pursued by a group. It looks like he didn't pay for his meal at the tavern.
5105222.ch: 你从城中离开，就看见酒尘正被一群人追打，看样子似乎是去酒馆吃了霸王餐没钱付账。

5105223.en: Sir, thank you for standing up and saving me!
5105223.ch: 哎呀老大，您仗义疏财，救了小兄弟我一条小命呐！

5105224.en: I just ate some of their rice and drank some of their alcohol. What's the big deal?
5105224.ch: 话说回来，不就是吃他家两口大米，喝几杯酒嘛，为啥这群人那么大火气……

5105225.ch: 啊啊啊！别丢下我不管呐……

5105226.en: JIuchen found a hole and started digging while you were asleep. Dust flies everywhere, but a he finds a grave in the hole.
5105226.ch: 这天，酒尘发现了一处泥坑。趁你午睡酣眠，他难忍本能驱使，动手刨了起来。一时间，泥土伴着石块在空中飞扬，隐约有坟头墓碑从坑中飞出。

5105227.en: Pig fiend! How dare you enter my residence?
5105227.ch: 大胆猪妖！竟敢擅动老娘的居所！

5105229.en: You have to be responsible for what your servant did!
5105229.ch: 哼，家奴如此，你这主人难辞其咎！

5105230.en: Seeing you taking an elixir, Jiuchen jumps out excitedly.
5105230.ch: 看到你服用丹药，酒尘兴冲冲地跳了出来。

5105232.en: I'll go back if you won't let me have any.

5105233.en: You're resting at the inn when Ningshuang sheepishly puts down something in front of you. You ask her a series of questions to discover that she stole it from other guests at the inn.
5105233.ch: 这天，你在客栈中休憩，突然厉凝霜神秘兮兮地将一件物品放在你面前。细问之下，你才得知，原来她昨夜竟悄悄溜进其他住客的房间偷取宝物。

5105234.en: Somene's trying to flirt with me
5105234.ch: 哼，有个不长眼的家伙，竟敢调戏于我。

5105235.en: I'm already holding myself back by not killing him. Just take it.
5105235.ch: 我已经很克制了，没要了那家伙的狗命，这玩意你就收下吧。

5105236.en: See what Ningshuang placed in your hand,you will……
5105236.ch: 看着厉凝霜放到你手上的东西，你打算……

5105237.en: Oh? I didn't think you're such an upstanding person.
5105237.ch: 哦？没想到你还挺正直的。

5105238.ch: 那好吧，这次算那人走运。

5105239.en: Right, they won't have any use for it anyway. Here, you take it.
5105239.ch: 嗯，这玩意给那种人也是白瞎了，你用正好。

5105240.en: Ningshuang raises her brow when she hears someone naming a higher price, sending chills down their spine.
5105240.ch: 听到他人抬价，厉凝霜眉头一挑，一股寒意瞬间笼罩了抬价者的全身。

5105241.en: You are looking through items on the shelf in the market when you feel something strange. The temperature drops a little, and the owner's face is twisted.
5105241.ch: 你正在坊市的货架上挑选心仪的商品，突然觉得气氛有些不对。空气温度有些下降，老板的神情十分怪异。

5105242.en: Cangya might have seen something in the Immortal Wardrobe, and will not enter the shop. So you make him wait outside.
5105242.ch: 沧崖似乎在仙衣阁中窥视到什么事情，誓死也不进入店中，你只好让他在门外等候。

5105301.en: How could you waste the time available? You do nothing. Are you going to lie flat and sleep?
5105301.ch: 大好光阴，岂能浪费？你什么都不干，难道想要躺平睡觉不成？

5105302.en: Cangya sees the thunderbolt from the sky flashing down on your head and hurries to knock you out of its way.
5105302.ch: 沧崖眼看天上霹雳照你头顶闪落，忙纵身将你撞开。

5105303.en: You avoid it, but Cangya was struck in your place, and scorched.
5105303.ch: 你虽然因此逃过一劫，但沧崖却替你被雷劈得外焦里嫩。

5105304.en: Seeing their fierce argument, the king-hearted Cangya can't help but speak up to quieten the fight.
5105304.ch: 看见二人激烈争执，宅心仁厚的沧崖忍不住出言劝架。

5105305.en: The two of them blame Cangya for being nosy, so they turn their spears on him. They are surprised when Cangya knocks them down instantly with a fist and a kick.
5105305.ch: 二人责怪沧崖多事，不由分说便先将矛头对准了他。可万没想到，沧崖手起一拳，腿发一脚，瞬间将二人打倒。

5105306.en: The two people did not expect Cangya to be so powerful, and thought he was a robber blacking their way to rob them. They quickly offer up the Spirit Stones they have on them, and Spiritual Fruit too, then run away in a flash.
5105306.ch: 二人未料沧崖如此厉害，以为他是拦路打劫的大盗，忙献出身上的灵石，随后也顾不上灵果，竟一溜烟地跑了。

5105307.en: You are browsing the Bounty Board with great interest. Ningshuang was indifferent as she browsed but suddenly rips off a few sheets from the board.
5105307.ch: 你正在兴致盎然地浏览悬赏榜，原本抱胸冷眼看着的凝霜突然撕下了榜上的几张单子。

5105308.en: You really want to know what Ningshuang is up to, but she turns away and leaves. She takes no notice of you, leaving you standing with a stunned expression on your face.
5105308.ch: 虽然你很想知道凝霜究竟在做什么，但她转身就走，并未理会，只留下你一脸愕然地站在原地。

5105309.en: However, it didn't take long before Ningshuang comes back. She presses the torn list to your face.
5105309.ch: 然而没过多久，凝霜便已回来，她将撕下的榜单一把按在你脸上。

5105310.en: Ha! Mission complete! Time to get the reward!

5105311.en: The Roro Bird attack movements are swift, but are still detected by Ningshuang, who has always had keen senses.
5105311.ch: 罗罗鸟来袭之势虽然迅疾，但还是被一向感官敏锐的凝霜察觉了。

5105312.en: Ningshuang has the Roro Bird in a chokehold, and thus you avoid it.
5105312.ch: 凝霜一把将罗罗鸟掐脖锁喉，你因此避过一劫。

5105313.en: Ningshuang has the struggling Roro Bird in her grip, and seems a little unsure of what to do.
5105313.ch: 凝霜掐着正在挣扎罗罗鸟，似乎有点不知道应该怎么处置。

5105315.en: You and Ningshuang roast the giant bird and have a feast.
5105315.ch: 你与凝霜将巨鸟烤熟，饱餐一顿。

5105316.en: You release the giant bird. The bird flaps its wings and flies a distance in a flash.
5105316.ch: 你将巨鸟释放，巨鸟扑腾翅膀眨眼远去。

5105317.en: Ningshuang blocks your way and waves her hand, releasing a heavy smoke screen and creating an opportunity for you to escape.
5105317.ch: 凝霜拦在你身前，将手一挥，释放出一重烟幕，给你制造了逃遁机会。

5105318.en: You both take advantage of the cover of the smoke screen and flee successfully.
5105318.ch: 你们借着烟幕掩护，撒开双腿，成功遁走。

5105319.en: The vicious monsters are nearing at great speed, but in this moment, Ningshuang is unhurriedly drawing a cute formation in the ground with a stick.
5105319.ch: 那些穷凶极恶的妖怪正在极速逼近过来，但就在此刻，身前的凝霜却不慌不忙地拿一支小树丫，在地上画了个可爱的图阵。

5105320.en: I have set up the "All Directions Death's Door Life-seeking Quick Shield of Hiding from Senses Elberethean Heavenly Technique" and the monsters in front of us can't see us temporarily.
5105320.ch: 我已设下“八方死门觅生切切遁隐天悟究极妙法”，前面妖物暂时看不见我们了。

5105321.en: The monsters seem to suddenly become unable to find your trail and are looking at each other in confusion. You and Ningshuang walk leisurely through the group of monsters.
5105321.ch: 那些妖怪似乎突然看不见你的踪迹，正在面面相觑觉得十分疑惑，而你便带着凝霜悠然地从怪物堆中穿行而过。

5105322.en: You are packing your gains from mining. Behind you, Jiuchen, who has mining knowledge, has reaped more rewards. He holds up a large piece of bright ore with both hands and brings it to you.
5105322.ch: 你正在收拾自己挖矿所得，身后对于矿藏颇有心得的酒尘另有收获，他双手捧起一大块亮晶晶的巨矿，送到你面前来。

5105323.en: You are frightened by the effects of the "Dark Eye" but Jiuchen sticks out his chest and tightens his abdomen, and tilts his head back to drink.
5105323.ch: 你正为“黑暗之眼”的影响而心惊胆战，不过酒尘在你面前挺胸收腹，仰头一喝。

5105324.en: You feel like you have been enlightened, and you regain your composure. The straightforward and trustworthy Jiuchen is at your shoulder, as if to say: Don't be afraid, you have me!
5105324.ch: 你感觉醍醐灌顶，重新镇静下来。憨厚而值得信赖的酒尘则勾搭着你的肩膀，仿佛在说：不怕，有我呢！

5105325.en: After the request fails, you are about to leave when suddenly, beside you, Muqing stares at the other party with large, puppy-dog eyes, and does not say a word.
5105325.ch: 索要失败后，你正打算离开，突然，身边的沐晴瞪大一双水汪汪的眼睛，一言不发地就这样凝望着对方。

5105326.en: After some time, the other party cannot resist Muqing's gaze and hands over the items you want to the adorable little Muqing.
5105326.ch: 相持许久后，对方还是没能抵抗住沐晴的凝视，将你想索要的物品交给了可爱的小沐晴。

5105327.en: You are filled with joy to be able to meditate in this place full of Qi. You look forward to realization and the attainment of cultivation, but a long time passes and you find no growth in the surrounding Qi.
5105327.ch: 你满心欢喜的在这处充满灵气的地方进行打坐，期望有所领悟获得修为，但是许久过去，你发现周身灵气毫无增长。

5105328.en: ...Why is the cultivation level not increasing?!

5105329.en: You are filled with doubt. Just then, the remaining bit of Qi drifts past you and is sucks away by Lingge, who is meditating behind you.
5105329.ch: 正在你满腹疑云之际，仅余的一丝灵气从你身边悠悠飘过，被正在身后打坐的菱歌吸走。

5105330.en: Mmm! The Qi here is really tasty! My Soul Realm seems to have become more stable. Hahaha!
5105330.ch: 嗯，这里的灵气还真是美味！我的魂境似乎愈发稳固了，哈哈哈。

5105331.en: The Pearl Turtle bites you hard, and flailing your hands about doesn't rid you of the monster fish's bite. If this goes on, you are bound to be injured.
5105331.ch: 你被珠鳖鱼狠狠咬住，左右甩手也无法摆脱怪鱼的噬咬。这样下去你定会被咬伤。

5105332.en: At that moment, Lingge used some technique and removes the monster fish from your hand. She holds it, immensely pleased with herself.
5105332.ch: 就在这时，菱歌不知道使用了什么手法，竟然一下就将怪鱼从你的手上取下，并捧在手上洋洋自得。

5106001.en: You can take me away from the underworld? I must repay you for this.
5106001.ch: 阁下竟能将我带离冥界？此番恩情，在下必有回报。

5106011.en: I didn't think the world down here is as dangerous as the heavenly realm, but I couldn't help you shoulder the burden. What a shame...
5106011.ch: 没想到这八荒与仙界同样杀机四伏，而我却无力为你承受此番劫难，可惜……

5106021.en: You... you know the revival technique! This is a taboo even in the heavenly realm. Who are you?
5106021.ch: 你……你竟通晓还阳之法！此术在仙界都被列为禁忌，你究竟是何等人物……

5106033.en: You're talented. If you cultivate more, you are destined for great things.
5106033.ch: 你天质不错，若勤加修炼，必有成就。

5106041.en: These tests will strengthen your mind.
5106041.ch: 接受这样的考验，能磨砺你的心志！

5106042.en: The thunders look a little over the top.
5106042.ch: 这漫天打雷的状况看着还是有点唬人。

5106043.en: I heard that you could get blown to pieces in a trial if you're not careful, but I think you'll be fine.
5106043.ch: 听说渡劫稍有不慎会灰飞烟灭，想必你应该不会陷入那般境地。

5106051.en: We've got trouble! Let's get it over with quickly.
5106051.ch: 有人来找麻烦了，速战速决！

5106053.en: Good thing you're here. I almost forgot what I'm capable of.
5106053.ch: 来得正好，我这身本事再撂下可就都忘了。

5106061.en: Why don't they just tell us what they want? We're not that unreasonable, are we?
5106061.ch: 这人也真是的，想要什么可以直说嘛，我们又不是不讲道理的人。

5106062.en: What did they steal from you?
5106062.ch: 那人从你身上摸出什么好东西了？

5106071.en: This place is far from peaceful, but it's great for cultivation.
5106071.ch: 这块地方虽不太平，但的确挺适合修炼。

5106072.en: It's going to get really dangerous from here, don't say I didn't warn you.
5106072.ch: 从这边进去之后就是凶险的所在了，不要说我没提醒你哦。

5106081.en: That's a lot of techniques. But they're all for humans, so I can't learn them. What a shame...
5106081.ch: 哇哦，这么多的功法呀！可惜都是你们人类之物，我无法修炼，真是眼馋呐……

5106082.en: The techniques in these books make a lot of sense. I should copy them and study!
5106082.ch: 唔，这些书里面的道法功诀都很有道理，可以摘抄下来好好研究！

5106083.en: You humans have a lot of techniques that I can learn from.
5106083.ch: 我发现，你们人类的功法有很多地方都值得我借鉴!

5106092.en: I'm glad I can help you with your revenge. I've finally repaid you.
5106092.ch: 能协助你对付仇人，总算报了你对我恩惠的万一。

5106093.en: How many more enemies do you have? Just bring them all here.
5106093.ch: 你还有几个仇人？让他们都过来吧！

5106096.en: What's wrong? Why do you look so negative?
5106096.ch: 最近可是有所不顺？为何看你满脸戾气？

5106098.en: Are you... trying to get something from your friend?
5106098.ch: 你……是想从你朋友身上得到什么嘛？

5106099.en: Why did you do this? Did you have a good reason to?
5106099.ch: 你这样做是不是有苦衷？！

5106100.en: You should never kill your family again.
5106100.ch: 此事一之为甚，以后不要随意杀害亲族了！

5106101.en: I'm really worried. If this keeps going, you will get addicted to killing.
5106101.ch: 这实在让我很忧心，这样下去，你早晚会养成滥杀的性子。

5106102.en: Are you... straying from your path?
5106102.ch: 你是不是有点坠入魔道了？

5106111.en: Just a little more. What a shame.

5106115.en: Please listen to me. You should let it go.
5106115.ch: 听我一劝，今日暂且作罢。

5106116.en: They're already too far. You can't catch up.
5106116.ch: 走得远了，怕是赶不上啦。

5106117.en: They're your friend after all. Don't go after them.
5106117.ch: 此人好歹是你朋友，别追了。

5106118.en: The more you kill, the harder it is to stay true to your path. It's time to stop.
5106118.ch: 多杀一人，你保持道心的难度就增加一分，该停了。

5106121.en: Do you know them? Are you friends or enemies? Should we go after them?
5106121.ch: 你跟这个人有故？交情是好是坏？要不要追上去。

5106131.ch: 恭喜恭喜，袍泽之情，最是可贵。

5106132.en: I'm thinking about my sister now. I wonder where she is....
5106132.ch: 唉，想起姐姐了。姐姐，如今你在哪呢？

5106133.en: You should keep in touch with them, don't be like me and my sister...
5106133.ch: 你可要时常跟人家联系，不要像我跟我姐姐，许久没有音讯了。

5106141.en: You should never triumph over small victories. They only make you more complacent.
5106141.ch: 小胜更应戒骄，勿要得意忘形。

5106143.en: Unlike sparring, you might die while fighting an enemy.
5106143.ch: 切磋只分胜负，日后遇有仇敌，可不止分胜负了。

5106151.en: Do not be frustrated at a loss. Look inside of you, and one day you shall win.
5106151.ch: 一时之败，不要气馁，自反而缩，激起哀兵之气，早晚便要反败为胜。

5106153.en: Don't rush. If they can do it, so can you.
5106153.ch: 先不要急躁，别人可以，你也一样能行。

5106154.en: Seeing that you were turned down, loyal little Muqing can't help petting you on the head. You find it quite comforting.
5106154.ch: 你身边的小沐晴看你邀约失败，忍不住拿手轻轻抚摸你的头顶，对你好生安慰。

5106155.en: Seeing your failed proposal, Mengyi kindly uses her divination skills to figure out your future wife's identity. You find her attempts amusing.
5106155.ch: 梦衣看见你求婚被拒，于是掐指一算，要提前预知你日后妻子身份，好安慰于你。

5106156.en: Mengyi also uses her mystic powers to foresee your future wife's face and sketch it down on paper. However, she's unskilled in portrait painting and the results are less than satisfactory. At least it gives you a good laugh.
5106156.ch: 梦衣还使用神觇秘术替你占卜了日后妻子的样貌，并图画纸上。梦衣似乎于画画一道并不擅长，肖像画得歪瓜裂枣，但你还是笑逐颜开。

5106157.en: The devoted scholar Lingge, seeing that someone has refused to debate the art of cultivation with you, excitedly launches into a lecture about her latest learnings concerning the immortal arts.
5106157.ch: 痴迷于钻研道法的菱歌因为看见你被别个拒绝论道，所以她迫不及待地给你论了一番“道”，告诉了你她有关仙法秘术的新领悟。

5106158.en: According to her, all complicated immortal arts are fundamentally flawed. She calls the flaws "bugs" and has a lot to say about them.
5106158.ch: 按菱歌所说一切繁复仙法其实都存在缺陷，她姑且称呼这个缺陷为“霸格”，然后还细细谈论了她的所见。

5106159.en: With Lingge's explanation, you have a much better understanding of the immortal arts and feel greatly invigorated.
5106159.ch: 你听了菱歌的讲解，心中不少关于仙术的困惑瞬间解开，感觉振耳发聩，精神奋作！

5106160.en: You're lounging around strumming your favorite instrument one day. It's great to get a day off, but you suddenly feel the need to vent your feelings.
5106160.ch: 这天你正在半依坐席，把玩喜爱的乐器，虽然浮生得暇，但胸中颇有块垒，正想一抒胸臆。

5106161.en: Muqing, music enthusiast, senses your overflowing emotions and suggests that you play a song with her. Following her instructions, you play a song in a style you've never tried before. Exhilarating!
5106161.ch: 痴于乐道的沐晴觉得你略有愁情，于是建议来一场特别的合奏。沐晴对琴埙别有心得，你依着她的指点，弹琴吹埙一起演奏了首风格迥异从前的曲子，由此胸怀一爽！

5106162.en: You pull a jumble of random items out of your flimsy old pack, wanting to clean it. However, sweet Lingge picks all the items up.
5106162.ch: 你正在收拾那个不堪重负的临时背包，将里面一应乱七八糟的东西扔了出来。但你没想到，身后的菱歌将这些东西都一一拾起来了。

5106163.en: An avid potionmaster, Lingge brews these random items into a coal-like, smoking-hot pill and hands it to you. She named it the "ultimate cleansing enema pellet".
5106163.ch: 万物皆可入药的菱歌将你所丢掉的东西搓成一颗还冒着热气像煤炭一样的东西递到你面前。她声称手中之物是失传已久的“抽汞炼铅重楼碧城洗肠沐肝五绝丹”。

5106164.en: As horrified as you are, you don't like saying no to Lingge, so you still swallow the pill like a martyr. Miraculously, it makes you feel incredibly light, as if you could fly.
5106164.ch: 虽然你觉得这枚丹药十分可怕，但因为不忍心拒拂菱歌，你将药丸吞了下去。然而奇迹发生了，霎那间你有种脱身飞去的感觉，全身十分舒畅。

5106165.en: The crops ahead are shrouded with an ethereal mist. Under a mulberry tree, two men sit on stone chairs, playing chess.
5106165.ch: 前方田野仙气弥漫，一棵大桑树下，有两人分坐于南北方石凳上专心对弈。

5106166.en: The one facing the south is an old man with a long white beard yet a youthful, ruddy and kind face. The one facing the north is middle-aged with a short black beard, dark skin and a stern face.
5106166.ch: 坐南方者形似老者，白色长髯，鹤发童颜，面色红润，慈眉善目；坐北方者似中年人，黑发短须，皮肤黝黑，面色冷峻，不怒自威。

5106167.en: The two seem deep in thought. Thinking that the game must be intense, you approach to watch them play.
5106167.ch: 两人均在冥思苦想，看来棋局正在错综复杂之时。你忍不住上前观看。

5106168.en: The two don't acknowledge you and continue playing. After a round, they smile at each other and leave.
5106168.ch: 二人并未理会你，一局终了后相视一笑便飘然而去。

5106169.en: The middle-aged man wins the game. The old man guffaws and leaves.
5106169.ch: 中年人赢得了棋局，老者呵呵一笑飘然离去。

5106170.en: The middle-aged man still has his poker face on. "I won only because of your tips just now." he tells you.
5106170.ch: 中年人依然面色冷峻，“虽然在下此番胜之不武，但是方才阁下的指点倒也让在下茅塞顿开。”中年人说道。

5106171.en: To thank you, he asks you to tell him the name of one person, and he'll lower this person's max lifespan by 50 years.
5106171.ch: 为了报答于你，他非要你指定一个人，让此人寿命上限减少50年。

5106172.en: "You're truly a vicious one. May your cultivation path be long and smooth."
5106172.ch: “阁下手段狠辣，确实能在修仙之路上走得长远。”

5106173.en: The middle-aged man conjures up a puff of black smoke and vanishes into thin air. （{name|C}'s lifespan -50）
5106173.ch: 中年人丢下一句话后，随手挥出一道黑气后，便化作一团薄雾飘散了。 （{name|C}的寿命-50）

5106174.en: The middle-aged man nods and pulls out three Spiritual Fruits from inside his pack and vanishes into thin air.
5106174.ch: 中年人听后微微颔首，从囊中抓出三个灵果给你，随后化作一团薄雾飘散了。

5106175.en: The old man wins the round and the middle-aged man stands up silently to leave.
5106175.ch: 老者赢得了棋局，中年人默默起身离开。

5106176.en: The old man laughs. "So young, yet such an excellent chess player. A diamond in the rough!"
5106176.ch: 老者呵呵笑道，“年纪轻轻有如此棋艺，实在叫人欣喜！”

5106177.en: He asks you to tell him the name of one person, and he'll lengthen this person's max lifespan by 50 years.
5106177.ch: 他非要你指定一个人，让此人寿命上限增加50年。

5106178.en: "You care about others, I see. Very well."

5106179.en: The old man smiles, conjures up a puff of white smoke and vanishes into thin air. （{name|B}'s lifespan +50）
5106179.ch: 老者微微一笑，随手挥出一道白气后，便化作一团薄雾飘散了。 （{name|B}的寿命+50）

5106180.en: The old man grins and pulls out three Spiritual Fruits from inside his pack and vanishes into thin air.
5106180.ch: 老者听后笑意愈浓，从腰间摸出三个灵果给你，随后化作一团薄雾飘散了。

5106181.en: You drink the wine and feel instantly refreshed, as if surrounded by a chilling mist.
5106181.ch: 喝了此酒后，你感觉神清气爽，如坠云雾之中。

5106182.en: Too bad the middle-aged man noticed that you've stolen the wine and slaps you with his very wide sleeve.
5106182.ch: 不料，中年人发现了你偷酒喝，他怒而拂袖，袖风扑到面上。

5106183.en: You faint, and when you wake up, both men have disappeared.
5106183.ch: 你感觉两眼一黑便晕厥过去，醒来后发现二人早已不见影踪。

5106194.en: There are a lot of people up ahead. Should we take a look?
5106194.ch: 前面好像有个人，过去看看吧。

5106195.en: You inspect the person and realize that he's on the brink of death.
5106195.ch: 你查看一番，觉得此人气息不稳，似乎需要救助。

5106199.en: It shan't be that hard to kill this unconscious person...
5106199.ch: 杀死这个昏迷之人应该易如反掌…

5106203.en: We shouldn't stay here any longer. Let's get out together!
5106203.ch: 此地不宜久留，愿与道友闯出此地!

5106204.en: Suddenly, the person's eyes widen, as if in pain.
5106204.ch: 突然此人圆睁双眼，十分痛苦的样子。

5106205.en: Weakling. I shall end your struggles.
5106205.ch: 太虚弱了，尽是无用的挣扎。

5106206.ch: 你轻易的了结了他的性命。

5106207.en: You hear a loud scream from the distance. The unconscious cultivator has probably been killed.
5106207.ch: 远远传来一声惨叫，恐怕那个失去意识的修仙者已遭遇不测。

5106210.en: I'm sorry that I'm not strong enough. Take care of yourself...
5106210.ch: 我修为不足…且先撤退…道友保重…

5106213.en: If it weren't for your help, I would have perished today. To show my gratitude, this is for you.
5106213.ch: 若非遇到道友，只怕我已在此陨落…区区薄礼略表心意。

5106214.en: I will not forget your generosity. Should you need me in the future, don't hesitate to come to me.
5106214.ch: 道友今日救命之恩，在下没齿难忘!日后若有所需，在下定会鼎力相助!

5106215.en: What a coincidence! Didn't expect to meet you here.

5106216.en: You saved my life when I was in trouble.
5106216.ch: 之前我危难之时多亏你相救。

5106217.en: Oh, right, please wait here for me for a bit.

5106218.en: He rushes away and returns with something in his hands.
5106218.ch: 他急匆匆跑开，过了片刻又急匆匆跑回来，手上拿着什么东西。

5106219.en: I found this a couple days ago. It's all yours now!
5106219.ch: 这是前些日子寻得的宝物，赠给你吧!

5106220.en: None of this can repay a debt of life.
5106220.ch: 不过身外之物，何以报救命之恩。

5106222.en: I'm here to help, my friend!

5106224.en: To be honest with you, I have you marked... so that I can find you easier.
5106224.ch: 实不相瞒，我一直有神识标记关注于你。

5106225.en: I sensed you nearby so thought I'd come over.
5106225.ch: 日前感应到你在附近，就想过来看看。

5106226.en: I didn't expect you to be in the middle of a fight.
5106226.ch: 未曾想刚好遇到你在战斗。

5106231.en: Ha, show me what you've got!

5106232.en: The person suddenly dodges and moves backward.

5106233.en: You don't have an ounce of pity in you, huh?
5106233.ch: 你这人，怎么没点怜悯之心，惹不起惹不起!

5106234.en: Before you know it, the person has run off.
5106234.ch: 一没留神，对方已经跑远了…

5106235.en: Before you can react, the person suddenly attacks you!
5106235.ch: 还未等你反应，此人突然暴起攻击你!

5106239.en: A shadow flashes out of sight, as if trying to hide from you.
5106239.ch: 一个身影匆匆离开了，似乎在躲避你。

5106240.en: <r>A cultivator is approaching. They don't seem to have the best intentions in mind.</r>
5106240.ch: <r>有修仙者在靠近，似乎来者不善。</r>

5106244.en: My fault, my fault! I shouldn't have attacked you for your money!
5106244.ch: 我错了我错了，是我财迷心窍竟然想去刺杀你!

5106245.en: It's all yours, it's all yours! Let me go!
5106245.ch: 这都给你都给你，放过我吧!

5106250.en: A monster indeed! How dare you harm me?
5106250.ch: 果然是个魔头!你竟然想向我下毒手?!

5106253.en: You think you can leave, monster?

5106255.ch: 没想到这样都杀不掉你…

5106257.ch: 废话少说, 把命留下!

5106258.en: Why do you keep calling me monster?
5106258.ch: 为何口口声声唤我作魔头?

5106259.en: Don't you know how many evil deeds you've done?
5106259.ch: 自己做过忒多恶行,你还装不知?

5106261.en:
Who's the one who steals from civilians in every town he goes to?
Monster materials, Heaven and Earth Treasures...
A filthy thief! Is that not you?
5106261.ch:
每到城镇, 必以念力探人物戒,
下到妖兽材料, 上及天材地宝, 
所盗繁多, 是也不是?

5106262.en:
Who's the one who seduces every female he sees?
From the young to the hundred-year-old ladies...
A filthy playboy! Is that not you?
5106262.ch:
每遇异性, 必诱其中美貌双修, 
小有年方二八, 老或百年大能, 
道侣遍布, 是也不是?

5106263.en:
Who's the one who kills the friends and family of every enemy he has?
Even the children, the old, the innocent.
A filthy murderer! Is that not you?
5106263.ch:
每结仇家, 必杀其人其亲其友, 
逢则决一死战, 来便目光一冷, 
饮魄无数, 是也不是?

5106264.en: You're a monster through and through. I'll kill you right here and now in the name of justice!
5106264.ch: 还说不是魔头, 我今日便要除魔卫道, 把命留下!

5106267.en: ...If it's a misunderstanding, I'm very sorry. I'll repay you some other day.
5106267.ch: …既是误会, 多有得罪, 来日再行补偿

5106268.en: I've been following your every move the past few months...
5106268.ch: 过去数月, 我均在留意你之言行…

5106269.en: Turns out I've really misunderstood you.
5106269.ch: 未料想, 真是被我错怪了…

5106270.en: Unfortunately, I'm poor, so there's nothing I can repay you with...
5106270.ch: 我身无长物, 实在无以弥补…

5106271.en: If you don't mind, how about I join you in your cultivation process for a couple days?
5106271.ch: 你若不嫌弃…不如我陪你修炼几日如何…?

5106272.en: I'll do my best to help you with whatever you need these days as a way to repay you...
5106272.ch: …这几日我必定尽力相待…权作补偿…

5106273.en: In that case, I won't force you. Farewell, then.
5106273.ch: 你既无意, 我也无话可说…后会有期

5106274.en: I see that you're a decent fellah, but there's no need. I could handle it myself.
5106274.ch: 嗯，小子人不错，勿需费力了，我本就无大碍。

5106275.en: Do you even know who I am? I'm {post|B} from {school|B}.
5106275.ch: 你可知我是谁?我便是{school|B}的{post|B}。

5106276.en: Even though I didn't need it, I'm grateful that you've stopped to help. I promise that we will meet again someday.
5106276.ch: 今日你既有心相救，虽非我所需，我也许你一份机缘，来日再会。

5106278.en: How dare you do something so shameless?

5106279.en: You must pay with your life!

5106280.en: The sound of a battle comes from a distance. Perhaps the cultivator you saw just now had gotten into a fight.
5106280.ch: 远远传来打斗之声，也许是方才失去意识的修仙者。

5106281.en: Ugh, I'll be back to teach you a lesson some other day!
5106281.ch: 哼，来日再教训你这竖子!

5106283.en: I'm on the way out to handle an affair with my disciples.
5106283.ch: 我正要与门中弟子外出办事。

5106284.en: I remember that you're quite a cultivation expert. Will you give my disciple here some tips?
5106284.ch: 我记得你修为不浅，可愿意指点我这弟子一二?

5106287.en: Very well, kid. Quite talented, too. You have a bright future ahead of you.
5106287.ch: 你小子确实人不错，资质也算上乘，大有可为啊。

5106288.en: Ha, I've got something else to do today. Come visit me when you have time!
5106288.ch: 哈哈哈，今日我还有要事，有空来门中做客。

5106289.en: Kid, are you here to see me?

5106291.en: Are you interested in the secret techniques of my sect?
5106291.ch: 可对我门中秘法有兴趣?

5106292.en: Heh. Here's one of the secret techniques. It's yours now.
5106292.ch: 哈哈哈，这是我宗门秘法之一，就赠与你了。

5106362.en: Try not to overestimate yourself. Take care, alright?
5106362.ch: 以后还是不要逞强了，注意保护好自己哟。

5106363.en: Don't let my compliments get to your head.
5106363.ch: 夸你两句还得意上了，嘻嘻。

5106364.en: A humble one. I like you already.

5106365.en: Alright, we'll do what you say.

5106366.ch: 嗯？那要不再多准备一下吧……

5106367.en: It's good to be humble, but you did show me a new thing or two.
5106367.ch: 懂得谦逊是好事，但此法确实让老夫大开眼界。

5106368.en: That's an amazing skill. You don't need to be humble about it.
5106368.ch: 小友奇技傍身，不必过谦！

5106369.en: If you keep it up, you'll eclipse your master one day.
5106369.ch: 你若持之以恒，终将青出于蓝。

5106370.en: Cultivators must not rush. One step at a time.
5106370.ch: 修仙之人最忌急躁，步步为营才是正道。

5106371.en: Well, I've been in the same pose for a long time, and was just about to stretch a little.
5106371.ch: 那是，我静极思动，正想舒展一下筋骨呢！

5106372.en: It's good that you're open to new ideas.

5106377.en: Don't mess around. Let's go together.

5106378.en: Is that alright? But they'll probably just attack me. Hm. Maybe not.
5106378.ch: 喔？可以吗？估计它们只会傻傻地攻击我，还是算了吧。

5106379.en: Why are you laughing? You scared me!
5106379.ch: 你傻笑什么，刚才可把沐晴吓坏了……

5106388.ch: 就这点货色你应付不了？

5106390.en: That feels nice and cold! Can I have one, too?
5106390.ch: 喔！好凉！可以给我也整一块吗？

5106391.en: It's good to have goals, but don't put too much stress on yourself.
5106391.ch: 有目标是好事，可也莫要太过逼迫自己。

5106392.en: I was too eager to reach my goal back in the days, and it actually slowed down my progress.
5106392.ch: 当年我急于求成，偏偏难有寸进。这种心态实不可取。

5106395.en: I actually slept for such a long time... Huh? This is... There's no need to be so formal. Let's speak casually.
5106395.ch: 本尊竟沉睡了如此之久……嗯？阁下这是……不必拘谨，免礼平身吧。

5106396.en: I did not expect that my heart would ache for people who are not of my tribe. I really shouldn't...
5106396.ch: 没想到，有一天本尊也会因非我族类之人而感到心痛，实在是不该……

5106397.en: I've been killing since I was a child, and seen plenty of life and death. But I am still saddened by this scene... I truly am not worthy to be emperor...
5106397.ch: 纵使从小便杀伐决断、见惯生离死别，可面对此景，本尊仍旧难免悲切……我真不是个合格的帝王……

5106398.en: What?! The mortal world also has a way to bring back the dead? Huh? Why do I suddenly feel so relieved?
5106398.ch: 什么！原来下界也有起死回生之妙法。嗯？为什么本尊突然感到如此安心？

5106399.en: This breath... Looks like it really has come back to life again... Do not think that you will get to see my ugly, sad and tearful appearance.
5106399.ch: 这气息，看样子是真的活过来了……你可休想看到本尊伤心垂泪的丑态。

5106400.en: Yeah! Train hard! This is the best way to become worthy of being my companion.
5106400.ch: 嗯！勤加修行，这才配当本尊的同伴！

5106401.en: I have always appreciated progressive people. Meeting you today has made me quite happy.
5106401.ch: 本尊素来欣赏上进之人，今与你一见，心中甚喜。

5106402.en: Seeing you work so hard, I will be sure to reward you with an official position if you do ascend to the immortal world one day.
5106402.ch: 瞧你如此努力，若有朝一日你得飞升仙界，本尊必定赏你个官儿做。

5106403.en: A small trial of lightning can be dispersed with the flick of a finger and is not worth being troubled over... Ah, I'll leave the following to you.
5106403.ch: 小小雷劫，弹指可破，不足挂齿……嗯，接下来的事就交给你了。

5106404.en: Hmph. A puny thief dares to attempt to sneak in. That's just asking to get killed.
5106404.ch: 哼，竟有宵小之辈妄图偷袭，真是自取灭亡。

5106405.en: Oh? Some ants are begging to be stepped on. You can grant their wish.
5106405.ch: 哦？某些蝼蚁既想求死，你就成全其这桩心愿吧，

5106406.en: Ugh, I tire of these lowly tasks.
5106406.ch: 唉，这等下三滥之事，实在令本尊厌烦。

5106407.en: An ordinary man commits no crime, but a talented man arouses envy. Perhaps there really is no avoiding things like these...
5106407.ch: 匹夫无罪，怀璧其罪，这种事或许还真没法避免……

5106408.en: If I release so much as a trace of flaming Dragon Breath, the living beings here will probably all run away, hahaha!
5106408.ch: 若本尊释放一丝灼龙之息，怕是此地生灵便都会遁逃而去了，哈哈哈。

5106409.en: I cannot help but be elated at the sight of the mortal world flourishing.
5106409.ch: 看见下界各族如此繁盛，本尊也不禁倍感畅快。

5106410.en: The principle of life and death is common among the various tribes, and all follow the laws of heaven and earth. There is nothing else.
5106410.ch: 各族生杀，此乃自然之理，一切遵循天地法则而运转，此外更无他物。

5106411.en: Hm... This list... It makes me recall some matters of the past...
5106411.ch: 唔……这榜，倒让本尊回忆起些许往事……

5106412.en: Number one... Is reputation so important? Perhaps. Perhaps things like reputation are more than what I think they are.
5106412.ch: “第一”……虚名就真的那么重要么？或许是吧，可能虚名承载的东西，比本尊料想的更多。

5106413.en: To struggle for a goal is also the entirety of my life, though I cannot say if that is right or wrong...
5106413.ch: 为一个目标而奋斗，也是本尊人生的全部，虽然本尊也说不好那是对是错……

5106414.en: The person who offended you shall only meet with death.
5106414.ch: 得罪了你的人，死亡必将是其唯一的下场。

5106415.en: Purging the mortal world of those deserving death is also my responsibility.
5106415.ch: 肃清下界该死之人，也是本尊的责任。

5106416.en: You can kill those who should be killed, but do not let your mind be affected by killing.
5106416.ch: 杀些该杀之人便也罢了，可切勿被杀念影响了心神。

5106417.en: Do what you want. I will not say more on the matter.
5106417.ch: 你要做便做，我自不会多言。

5106418.en: Do you really have to go to such an extent?
5106418.ch: 真的需要做到这般地步吗？

5106419.en: To kill so decisively must mean that there was evidence to support the action. I hope you do not regret what you've done.
5106419.ch: 杀伐决断，理应有所凭据，希望你不要对自己所行之事感到后悔。

5106420.en: Hmph. Death is just around the corner, but the legs are still so swift...
5106420.ch: 哼，死到临头了，腿脚还能这么利索……

5106421.en: The first one was avoided, but not the fifteenth. What's the point of living a little longer?
5106421.ch: 躲得过初一躲不过十五，多苟活一阵又有何意义……

5106422.en: A person like that managed to give you the slip? Looks like you need to increase your travel speed.
5106422.ch: 能被此人走脱，看来你的脚力还需提升。

5106423.en: If it's gone, it's gone. This is also fate for you two.
5106423.ch: 走了便走了，这也是你二人的一番命数。

5106424.en: Uh... Why did you make a move against that person?

5106425.en: You must have had a reason for doing this, and I won't comment.
5106425.ch: 你如此做，想必有所缘由，本尊便不多评议。

5106426.en: Leaving is good. You should act carefully and not let your relatives shun you.
5106426.ch: 走了也好，你且慎重行事，勿要寒了亲族之心。

5106427.en: I do not know what is in your thoughts. I on;y hope that you don't forget your original intention and have no qualms.
5106427.ch: 本尊不知你心中所想，只愿你勿忘初衷、无愧于心。

5106428.en: How can a child ever repay a parent's love?
5106428.ch: 父母之恩，云何可报，慈如河海，孝若涓尘。

5106429.en: If you find it difficult to agree with what your parents say, reflect on them after some time has passed. These are my sincere words.
5106429.ch: 若觉得父母之言难以苟同，不妨过些时日再去回想，此乃本尊一番肺腑之言。

5106430.en: Not bad. It's like me in my younger days.
5106430.ch: 不错，颇有本尊当年风范。

5106431.en: Victories won by strength makes one feel delight, does it not?
5106431.ch: 靠实力赢得的胜利，的确让人心情愉悦，对吧？

5106432.en: It's okay, it's good to experience setback in order to steel your heart.
5106432.ch: 无妨无妨，经历些挫折也好磨砺心性。

5106433.en: This is how things are. Even I do not walk unhindered.
5106433.ch: 世事大抵如此，便是本尊也不曾一路无阻。

5106434.en: I didn't think I would see the light of day again... Well then, visiting the immortal world might not be a difficult thing. Would you, uh... Please guide me well.
5106434.ch: 没想到我还有重见天日的一天……既如此，再临仙界或许也不是什么难事。你，呃……多多指教。

5106435.en: I would be willing to die 10,000 times for my companion... But why...
5106435.ch: 就是让我为同伴死一万次，我也愿意……可为什么……

5106436.en: Am I fated to never escape, and watch as others sacrifice their lives...?
5106436.ch: 难道我注定逃不开，只能眼睁睁看着他人牺牲的命运么……

5106437.en: Why? I was planning on finding out where to go to find blood to make full use of the Revival Needle. How did you come to life on your own?
5106437.ch: 什么？我还在想去哪找血引来施展还阳绵针，你怎么自己就活了？

5106438.en: Do you also have the molting ability? Was what died earlier your clone?
5106438.ch: 难道你也会蛇蜕之法？刚刚死掉的那具，是你的分身？

5106439.en: Breakthroughs at such a young age? Oh, how I envy you.
5106439.ch: 如此年纪便屡有突破，真是羡煞我也。

5106440.en: Life is but a journey, and we just have different destinations... Whatever the case, congratulations on your advancement in cultivation.
5106440.ch: 人这一生，不过是在旅途中前行，只是彼此想要去到的终点不尽相同……不管怎样，还是恭喜你修为精进。

5106441.en: Ha. I hope the higher realm will enable you to do what you want more easily.
5106441.ch: 哈，希望更高的境界，能让你更容易做到自己想做的事。

5106442.en: This Trial of Lightning has great prestige, but you are sure to pass it safely with your cultivation level.
5106442.ch: 这雷劫虽然声势不小，但以你的修为必然能够安然渡过。

5106443.en: Since they've delivered themselves to the doorstep, let's let them have their wish.
5106443.ch: 既然都已送上门来，那便送此人个求仁得仁罢。

5106444.en: I've never liked killing, but there are people who always test the limits of danger... Look, they've come.
5106444.ch: 我本不喜杀生，可总有人非要在危险的边缘试探……你看，这不是来了？

5106445.en: Why this pilfering... Ahem. This person's clumsy tricks won't fool my eyes!
5106445.ch: 偷鸡摸狗……咳咳，此人的拙劣伎俩休想瞒过我的法眼！

5106446.en: This person's gaze is unsteady, movements slow, steps too relaxed, and reactions too slow... What sort of thief is this?
5106446.ch: 此人眼神闪烁、下手缓慢、脚步松散、反应迟钝，就这也想当小偷？

5106447.en: This place is separate from danger and safety, but this feeling of being in the midst of hostility makes me think fondly of...
5106447.ch: 虽然此地无关安危，但这种置身于敌意中的感觉，还真是让我怀念……

5106448.en: When I was wandering the Immortal World, I never seized victory with force... Hm, indeed, it's because other races cannot be beaten with brute force.
5106448.ch: 我混迹仙界的时候，可从来不以力取胜……呃，确实是因为用蛮力也打不过其他种族啦。

5106449.en: Let me see if there are any pig demons here!
5106449.ch: 让我看看此地有没有猪妖！

5106450.en: Huh? This is there place where you humans "take dragon form"?
5106450.ch: 喔？这就是你们人族“化龙”的地方吗？

5106451.en: Immortal Arena? Can I ascend to the Immortal World from here?
5106451.ch: 升仙台？我可以在这里飞升到仙界去？

5106452.en: What is the Taoist Fruit? Will I be able to comprehend XII after I eat it? That truly is amazing.
5106452.ch: 道心果是何物？吃完就能参悟大道？那可真是神奇。

5106453.en: Yes, destroying root and branch to eliminate future problems is also a method I employ against enemies.
5106453.ch: 嗯，斩草除根以绝后患，也是我对待仇人的方式。

5106454.en: I am not a murderous person, but I am not a fool either. I do quite admire you.
5106454.ch: 我虽不是嗜杀之人，却也不是愚善之辈，我对你可很是欣赏呢。

5106455.en: If you do make a move, do not hesitate. I'll be with you every step of the way.
5106455.ch: 若真该出手，便无需犹豫，我始终与你一同前行。

5106456.en: Remember not to make too many enemies. It doesn't hurt to be cautious.
5106456.ch: 记得可别树敌太多，谨慎些总没坏处。

5106457.en: How could you... do something like this...

5106458.en: How could you act in this way? To kill your own relatives... Does this person not have a line too far to cross?
5106458.ch: 对亲族狠下杀手，你怎会这般行事。嗯……难道此人曾有何过分的行径？

5106459.en: It will be difficult to absolve my heart of hatred if I don't kill this person.
5106459.ch: 不杀此人，实在难解我心头之恨。

5106460.en: As you wish. I will pursue this person to the ends of the earth with you.
5106460.ch: 若你愿意，我便与你追此人到海角天涯。

5106461.en: It's too bad that person got away. What to do next all depends on you now.
5106461.ch: 可惜竟让此人逃脱，接下来如何全看你了。

5106462.en: Did you think you could escape? Stop right there...
5106462.ch: 你以为你能逃得了吗！……别跑……

5106463.en: This person seemed to treat you well. Did something anger you?
5106463.ch: 此人似乎对你不错，莫非哪里触怒了你？

5106464.en: I don't think I really understand you, but you don't have to be concerned about it.
5106464.ch: 我有些看不懂你，不过你也无需在意。

5106465.en: What are you trying to do here? Is there some deep, hidden meaning?
5106465.ch: 你这是要做什么，莫非暗藏深意？

5106466.en: Did they get away...? This is your family's business, but I still can't stand that...
5106466.ch: 逃走了么……此虽是你家事，但我仍然不忍……

5106467.en: From today onwards, you are of the same family. Cherish each other!
5106467.ch: 从今天起，你们就算是“同族”了，以后可要好好珍惜彼此！

5106468.en: Fellowship is rare. Perhaps you will have some progress in your cultivation if you think of each other!
5106468.ch: 同胞之谊，实在难得，想到对方，也许你修行能更进几分！

5106469.en: This is a wonderful debate on martial matters, and I can't contain my eagerness to try it.
5106469.ch: 以武论道，实在妙极，看得我也不禁跃跃欲试。

5106470.en: A meeting in the Immortal World prompts fights to the death between them, unlike in the mortal world, where there is more peace and happiness.
5106470.ch: 仙界诸族之间，往往相见便是生死相残，倒不如下界这般多有和乐。

5106471.en: There is no need to fret over such a trivial matter.

5106472.en: I recall my time in the Immortal World as one fraught with danger approaching at any time. The fun of sparring with someone of the same tribe was greatly diminished.
5106472.ch: 想我在仙界之时，终日提心吊胆，随时可能身陷险境，倒真少了与同族切磋的乐趣。

5106473.en: With my dragon breath protecting you, those lowly monsters would never dare get close.
5106473.ch: 有本尊龙息相护，宵小妖物必然不敢近身。

5106474.en: "You are not strong enough to fully activate the Flaming Dragon Breath," says Yaoyue regretfully.
5106474.ch: “你的修为还太低了，灼龙之息目前还发挥不出作用。”遥月有些遗憾的说着。

5106475.en: Thunder and lightning, heed my call!

5106480.en: Since you are the leader of a sect, do you know something about statecraft?
5106480.ch: 你既身为一宗之主，可曾听闻过人君南面之术？

5106481.en: Let blood enhance the bone. Let yin and yang coalesce in the soul. Arise!
5106481.ch: 以血为引，塑骨凝身，化阴生阳，九转还魂，起！

5106482.en: Hehe, if I can blend these poisons within me, I will grow even stronger.
5106482.ch: 嘿嘿，若能让这些毒在体内融合，我的实力便会再强上一分。

5106483.en: Do you want to give it a taste? If you are poisoned, I can detoxify you at once.
5106483.ch: 你要不要试着尝一颗？若是中毒的话，我也可以随时为你解毒。

5106484.en: I changed the item back. Put this away.
5106484.ch: 喏，我换东西回来了，这个你收好。

5106485.en: You question him repeatedly, and only then does he stammer and tell you that after he molted he took his scales and exchanged them for the {#item_name5111302} with the boss of the Immortal Wardrobe.
5106485.ch: 你再三询问之下，他才支支吾吾的说道，自己蜕皮后拿着鳞片与仙衣阁的老板换来了{#item_name5111302}。

5106486.en: You question him repeatedly, and only then does he stammer and tell you that after he molted he took his scales and exchanged them for the {#item_name5111301} with the boss of the Immortal Wardrobe.
5106486.ch: 你再三询问之下，他才支支吾吾的说道，自己蜕皮后拿着鳞片与仙衣阁的老板换来了{#item_name5111301}。

5106487.en: You question him repeatedly, and only then does he stammer and tell you that after he molted he took his scales and exchanged them for the {#item_name5111201} with the boss of the Immortal Wardrobe.
5106487.ch: 你再三询问之下，他才支支吾吾的说道，自己蜕皮后拿着鳞片与仙衣阁的老板换来了{#item_name5111201}。

5106488.en: You question him repeatedly, and only then does he stammer and tell you that after he molted he took his scales and exchanged them for the {#item_name5111101} with the boss of the Immortal Wardrobe.
5106488.ch: 你再三询问之下，他才支支吾吾的说道，自己蜕皮后拿着鳞片与仙衣阁的老板换来了{#item_name5111101}。

5106489.en: (A few days after the Venomous Fang disappeared, the scales were handed to you.)
5106489.ch: （毒齿消失几天后，将鳞片交予了你。）

5106490.en: (You exchange the scales for the {#item_name5111302} with the boss of the Immortal Wardrobe.)
5106490.ch: （你将鳞片与仙衣阁的老板换取了{#item_name5111302}。）

5106491.en: (You exchange the scales for the {#item_name5111301} with the boss of the Immortal Wardrobe.)
5106491.ch: （你将鳞片与仙衣阁的老板换取了{#item_name5111301}。）

5106492.en: (You exchange the scales for the {#item_name5111201} with the boss of the Immortal Wardrobe.)
5106492.ch: （你将鳞片与仙衣阁的老板换取了{#item_name5111201}。）

5106493.en: (You exchange the scales for the {#item_name5111101} with the boss of the Immortal Wardrobe.)
5106493.ch: （你将鳞片与仙衣阁的老板换取了{#item_name5111101}。）

5107001.en: Impudent scoundrel! Come at me if you dare, do not hurt my {call|B|A}!
5107001.ch: 大胆狂徒，有什么事情尽管冲着我来，休要伤害我的{call|B|A}！

5107002.en: If I must die today, I'll die in front of my {call|B|A}!
5107002.ch: 今日便是要死，也得让我死在我的{call|B|A}之前！

5107011.en: With a sudden ripping noise, you see a spatial rift appear in front of you. On the other side of it, there's {name|B}, who's attacked and in great danger. What should you do?
5107011.ch: 连心结上突然传来声响，一道空间裂缝在你眼前打开。裂缝那头，{name|B}正遭遇歹人毒手，性命危在旦夕。该如何行事呢？

5107021.en: I knew it! If I'm in danger, you'll always come save me!
5107021.ch: 我就知道，只要我遇到危险，你就一定会出现在我身边！

5107031.en: I'm truly blind to have provoked a friend of Your Holiness's! I deserve death! Please, Your Holiness, can you let me off the hook this one time for {0}'s sake?
5107031.ch: 小人有眼无珠，竟然招惹尊驾的亲近人，实在是罪该万死！还望尊驾大人大量，看在{0}的份上放小人一马。

5107032.en: It was all a misunderstanding! I was truly blind. Please, take this {0} and let me go.
5107032.ch: 误会误会！我这是昏了头，有眼不识泰山。这{0}您且收好，就把我放了吧。

5107033.en: You two have stuck together through thick and thin, a bond which many find quite enviable. All I wanted was to have someone to practice with. Please let me go alive for {0}'s sake, kind ones.
5107033.ch: 二位患难与共，实在是羡煞旁人。在下本意只是切磋道法，还望二位看在{0}的面子上高抬贵手，饶在下一命。

5107041.en: You wretches! Bullying others just because you have the numbers... Not fair at all!
5107041.ch: 卑鄙小人，竟然以多欺少，这算什么本事！

5107042.en: I don't know how you managed to set up the ambush, but I would never rest easy if a rascal like you succeed in your schemes!
5107042.ch: 哼，我不知你以何种方法设下埋伏，但被你这种小人得逞，真叫我死不瞑目！

5107043.en: Ugh, how could you strike while I was in a duel? What a despicable move!
5107043.ch: 可恶，竟然趁我与他人决斗之时暗下毒手，如此行径，我都替你感到羞耻！

5107051.en: ...Well, I can't stay for long. Farewell for now!

5108002.en: Come to Tian Yuan Mountain... I will always be waiting for you at Tian Yuan Mountain...
5108002.ch: 到天元山来...我会一直在天元山中等你...

5110001.en: caring more for swagger than safety while taking the stage, {name|A} slips, falls, and lands on the head with a troubling thud.
5110001.ch: {name|A}在登台之时只顾姿势飒爽，一不小心竟摔了一跤，而且还是头部着地，情况似乎十分不妙。

5110002.en: Ouch...... imagine seeing a Cultivator such as I in such a state......
5110002.ch: 好痛……我堂堂修仙之人，竟会如此狼狈……

5110011.en: An aura of malice suffuses the stage. It seems that {name|B}, unwilling to accept defeat, has converted part of their soul into energy for restoration...... some people will risk anything for victory, even their own path.
5110011.ch: 擂台之上突然煞气翻涌，原来是{name|B}眼见不敌对手，竟消耗元神来恢复气血……看来此人对胜利执迷太深，为了胜利不惜自毁道心。

5110012.en: I cannot lose...... I cannot lose...... defeat is not an option! Die, you wretch!
5110012.ch: 不能输……不能输……我绝对不能输！可恶的家伙，给我去死！！！

5110021.en: With your training, {call|B|A}, your foes must scatter at the slightest whisper of your name and yield without a fight!
5110021.ch: 以{call|B|A}你之修为，想必对方定然望风而逃、不战自退！

5110022.en: You are a prodigy, {call|B|A}, a Disciple of my Sect only seen once in a generation. As you go forth, you shall surely attain great heights and be known throughout the lands!
5110022.ch: {call|B|A}你乃我宗一代翘楚，此去必能独占鳌头、名震八荒！

5110023.en: Just as {name|A} is about to take the stage, friends of the opposite sex offer their fervent encouragement. Graciously accepting, {name|A} nonetheless felt flushed and off-balance, disrupting the flow of energy.
5110023.ch: 就在登台之前，{name|A}宗内的异性好友纷纷对其表达了鼓励。欣然接受后，{name|A}心绪激动、气血上涌，但是灵力似乎出现了一丝紊乱，感觉道法的施展没那么顺畅了。

5110024.en: Just as {name|A} is about to take the stage, friends of the opposite sex offer their fervent encouragement. And yet, in spite of these distractions, {name|A} remains unmoved and becomes even more focused on the battle to come.
5110024.ch: 就在登台之前，{name|A}宗内的异性好友纷纷对其表达了鼓励。然而，面对眼前的花花草草，{name|A}丝毫没有半点兴趣。此刻，这人的眼里只有擂台上的胜负，其心中的战意也变得更加凌厉了几分。

5110031.en: As you and your opponent are locked in pitched battle, a Spirit Vein nearby bursts, sending a geyser of Spirit Stones into the air.
5110031.ch: 就在你与对方激战正酣之时，此处灵脉突然喷发，地底一下子涌出无数灵石。

5110032.en: Your opponent appraises you contemplatively, seemingly waiting for some sort of response.
5110032.ch: 你抬头看向对方，发现对手也正用一种玩味的目光看向你，似乎在等待你的某种回应。

5110041.en: Your opponent takes the hint and gives you a small nod. You both disengage and busy yourselves with gathering Spirit Stones.
5110041.ch: 对方收到了你的暗示，向你微微点头示意。你二人收起道法，匆忙埋头装起灵石。

5110042.en: It is fortunate that no one else has come this way to interrupt your gathering efforts. The two of you split the haul of Spirit Stones equally. By the time you are finished, your opponent is nowhere to be seen.
5110042.ch: 还好没有他人途径此处，你二人将地脉灵石瓜分干净。当你捡完灵石后，对方已没了踪影。

5110052.en: You hear the sound of someone coming your way. The two of you blanch, hurriedly hide what Spirit Stones you had picked up, and resume your battle.
5110052.ch: 可就在这时，突然有人来到了此处，你二人大惊失色，迅速藏起了灵石，继续作战。

5110062.en: With you out of the way, the Spirit Stones will be all mine!
5110062.ch: 只要把你解决，这儿的灵石可就都归我了！

5110063.en: As your ears prick to an unfamiliar sound, you suddenly feel the world spin around you. Your opponent took advantage of the distraction and hit you in the back of the head with a particularly large Spirit Stone. With a mad laugh, you turn around to face your enemy.
5110063.ch: 耳边传来一道声响，你正疑惑间，突然就感觉一阵天旋地转。原来对手如此卑鄙，竟对你暗中下手，用大块的灵石当做板砖笔直砸中了你的脑袋。你怒极反笑，立刻起身迎敌。

5110071.en: Your skull must be made out of hardwood! Fine, I'll just have my pick of these Spirit Stones over your dead body!
5110071.ch: 原来是个榆木脑袋……唉，看来这满地灵石，只能待我将你斩杀后独享了。

5110082.en: You grab a hefty Spirit Stone and crack it like a slab of brick against the back of your opponent's head. Too slow to evade, your opponent slumps over, unconscious.
5110082.ch: 就在这时，你用一块硕大的灵石当做板砖笔直砸中了对方的脑袋，对方闪躲不及，被你砸晕当场。

5110092.en: You grab a hefty Spirit Stone and crack it like a slab of brick against the back of your opponent's head. At the last moment, however, your opponent dodges out of the way and proceeds to unleash an expletive-laden rant against you.
5110092.ch: 就在这时，你用一块硕大的灵石当做板砖向对方脑袋砸去，岂料对方反应敏捷，一下闪身躲开后对你大骂不止。

5110101.en: At a pivotal moment in the battle, a Disciple rushes over with hobbled steps. "I bring ill tidings! Someone has taken advantage of the chaos and attacked our Sect! We are hurrying back to the rescue!"
5110101.ch: 正在战斗的紧要关头，一个弟子步履踉跄地冲了过来，口中大喊“大事不妙，有人趁乱袭击了我方宗门，你当随我当立刻回救！”

5110111.en: You return to the Sect with all haste. The Disciple was right. A band of suspicious looking individuals is scoping out the Sect Territory.
5110111.ch: 你火速返回宗门，似乎真的发现有一队鬼鬼祟祟之人在宗门领地外围窥探。

5110112.en: At the sight of your return, they vanish into thin air. You get a vague sense that something is wrong but can't quite put your finger on it.
5110112.ch: 这些人见你回宗，立刻消失无影。你冥冥之中感觉不对劲，却说不出为什么。

5110121.en: You return to the Sect with all haste, only to run straight into a horde of rampaging Beasts!
5110121.ch: 你火速返回宗门，正巧遇上了来势汹汹的兽潮。

5110122.en: When the Beast horde detects the breath of the Spirit Vein on you, they turn and speed towards the open Vein.
5110122.ch: 兽潮从你身上闻到了灵脉的气息，竟调转方向，朝着那处灵脉进发而去。

5110123.en: Thus, the Beast horde that was heading for your Sect is vanquished. For your efforts, you receive a standing ovation upon your return.
5110123.ch: 原本冲向你宗门的兽潮就这样被你化解了，你回到宗内，得到了全宗上下的一片赞誉。

5110131.en: You decide to ignore this man for now and focus on the task at hand.
5110131.ch: 你决定不理会此人，先把手头这一票做完再说。

5110132.en: Seeing your determination, the Disciple frantically runs away. It was then that you realized that you had not seen their face before, and smelled a rat.
5110132.ch: 见你如此决断，那弟子又慌慌张张地跑开了，你这才发现，此人样貌你似乎并未在宗内见过，恐怕其中有些蹊跷。

5110142.en: Seeing your determination, the Disciple frantically runs away. Something may be amiss at the Sect. You decide to pack it in early and return.
5110142.ch: 见你如此决断，那弟子又慌慌张张地跑开了，也许宗门发生了什么事，还是早点收工回去看看吧。

5110151.en: Just as you are about to vanquish the Beast, you see a figure floating above the opposing Sect. As your eyes focus, you make out the opposing Sect Leader, {Sect Occupation}!
5110151.ch: 正当你破阵灭兽之际，只见对方宗门内缓缓飘起一人，你定睛观瞧，发现这人竟是对方宗门的宗主{宗门职位}。

5110162.en: At this point, I know that Fate is against me. These are the final hours of my Sect, but here, in sight of our two armies, I have a request for your Sect Leader.
5110162.ch: 事到如今，我自知天命难违，本宗气数已尽、时日无多，但在此两军阵前，我有一事恳请贵宗宗主成全！

5110163.en: In the Cultivator world, the strong prey upon the weak. It is only right that you act thusly. If you have any more words for me, utter them now.
5110163.ch: 修仙世界弱肉强食，在下如此行事实乃顺天应人、阁下若有何见教还望当面讲来。

5110164.en: This conflict between our Sects stems from our personal vendetta. I propose a duel between the two of us to determine the outcome of this battle, and to safeguard all our Disciples. Are you up to the challenge?
5110164.ch: 这宗门之争终归是你我二人的恩怨，若你能与我单挑决出生死，以定宗门战之胜负，则可保两宗无数弟子之平安，不知阁下可有此番胆量？

5110171.en: Good! Truly living up to your name as the one to destroy my sect! At the very least, crossing blades with you will ensure that my years of Cultivation will not have been in vain! After you!
5110171.ch: 好！不愧是将灭我宗之人，在下能与你交手一番，也不枉潜心修炼了如此多年！请！

5110191.en: A shame that the supposed destroyer is as meek as a mouse.
5110191.ch: 可叹将灭我宗之人竟是个胆小如鼠之辈，惜哉，痛哉……

5120001.en: Sect Leader, in order to ensure the fruitful development of our Sect, I would like to reallocate the staffing of various departments. Is this acceptable?
5120001.ch: 宗主，为满足本宗目前的发展需要，我欲重新调整本宗各部门人员配比，您可否同意？

If you harm them, you will <r>lose some of your Sect Contribution</r>, and your <r>Affinity</r> with other Disciples of the same Sect will be lowered. If you kill them, you will <r>lose a lot of your Sect Contribution</r>, and the other Disciples of the same Sect will <r>despise you</r>. Do you still want to attack this person?
5130001.ch: {name|B}是你所属宗门{school|B}的{post|B}，若对其出手，你将会<r>失去部分宗门贡献</r>并使同宗弟子对你的<r>好感降低</r>，若击杀此人，你将会<r>失去大量宗门贡献</r>并使同宗弟子对你<r>产生仇恨</r>，确定要攻击此人吗？

5130002.en: {name|B} is the {post|B} of your Sect, {school|B}. If you harm them, you will <r>lose all of your Sect Contribution</r>, and your <r>Affinity</r> with other Disciples of the same Sect will be lowered dramatically. If you kill them, you will <r>be kicked out of the Sect, and all Sect members will be out for your blood</r>. Do you still want to attack this person?
5130002.ch: {name|B}是你所属宗门{school|B}的{post|B}，若对其出手，你将会<r>失去全部宗门贡献</r>并使同宗弟子对你的<r>好感大幅降低</r>，若击杀此人，你将会<r>被逐出宗门并被全宗追杀</r>，确定要攻击此人吗？

5130003.en: {name|B} is the {post|B} of your Sect, {school|B}. Do you still want to attack this person?
5130003.ch: {name|B}是你所属宗门{school|B}的{post|B}，确定要攻击此人吗？

5130004.en: {name|B} is the {post|B} of your Sect, {school|B}. If you harm them, you will <r>lower the Loyalty</r> of the Disciples of the same Sect, your <r>Affinity</r> with other Disciples of the same Sect will be lowered, and the <r>Sect Reputation will also be lowered</r>. If you kill them, <r>the Sect Reputation will be lowered dramatically </r>. Do you still want to attack this person?
5130004.ch: {name|B}是你所属宗门{school|B}的{post|B}，若对其出手，你将会<r>失去宗门贡献</r>并使同宗弟子对你的<r>好感降低</r>，若击杀此人，你将会<r>失去大量宗门贡献</r>并使宗门弟子对你的<r>仇恨度增加</r>，确定要攻击此人吗？

5130011.ch: {name|B}是你的{relation|B|A}，若对其出手，你将会使其对你的<r>好感大幅降低</r>，若击杀此人，你将会被其亲族所仇视并可能<r>被寻仇报复</r>，确定要攻击此人吗？
